nodes.rationale: If map.on('load') never fires the spinner spins forever with no explanation — the worst UX failure mode in the app. A 10s timer converts silent failure into an actionable retry affordance; the timer must be scheduled before the load handler, not inside it.

Dispatch ladder is navigator.share -> clipboard text fallback -> explicit 'Copy link only' button; an AbortError from the native share sheet is treated as user cancellation and deliberately fires NO analytics event.

nodes.label: Quintile emoji attempt strip
nodes.rationale: Per-attempt score is bucketed into five emoji (>=90 green, >=70 yellow, >=50 orange, >=30 red, else black) and padded to exactly three squares so an incomplete run still renders a fixed-width strip.

nodes.label: daily_shared analytics schema (date, modesPlayed, method)
nodes.rationale: Schema was changed from {mode, method} to {date, modesPlayed, method} without a migration because no event had ever been fired with the prior shape. The descriptive method vocabulary (share-api / clipboard-text / clipboard-link) was kept over the spec's shorter names.

nodes.label: funworldmap:toast CustomEvent
nodes.rationale: Share feedback reuses the pre-existing window CustomEvent toast channel instead of introducing a new notification mechanism.

nodes.label: #daily/<date> no-mode launcher anchor route
nodes.rationale: A shared link lands a recipient on the launcher anchored to that date rather than starting a game, so they can play their own daily and re-share from the same block.

nodes.label: Daily puzzle removal (PR #97, 2026-05-30)
nodes.rationale: The entire daily-puzzle/retention feature these plans built was removed in PR #97; the plans carry a 2026-06-12 tombstone and are kept unmodified for history only — they must not be implemented from.

nodes.label: Phase 5a — A11y Axe Pass Implementation Plan
nodes.norm_label: phase 5a — a11y axe pass implementation plan

nodes.label: axe-core WCAG 2 AA per-surface audit
nodes.rationale: One AxeBuilder test per retention surface, extending the existing accessibility spec rather than forking a new e2e/a11y/ directory, so the established exclusion conventions stay in one place.

nodes.label: Per-surface descope rule (>1 day restyle)
nodes.rationale: If a single surface needs more than a working day of restyle, disableRules is applied to THAT surface's test only, with a code comment and a roadmap entry naming the rule ID. The rule exists to bound open-ended iteration on violations whose real fix is a design-level palette change.

nodes.label: MapLibre canvas + loading-splash axe exclusions
nodes.rationale: The WebGL canvas is inherently opaque to axe's color-contrast probe, and the ephemeral z-[200] splash is aria-hidden + pointer-events-none but still scanned; both exclusions are justified rather than blanket rule suppression.

nodes.label: GameOverOverlay warm-accent contrast backlog
nodes.rationale: The surface with known pre-existing WCAG 2 AA violations deferred from the 2026-04-19 remediation; flagged as the most likely to hit the one-day descope threshold because the warm-accent palette fails contrast broadly.

nodes.label: AxeBuilder .include() subtree scoping
nodes.rationale: For a component nested inside an already-audited surface, scoping axe to the block's subtree with .include() avoids re-reporting the surrounding surface's violations as noise.

nodes.label: docs/systems/daily-puzzle.md system overview
nodes.rationale: Single page covering lifecycle, storage shape, routing matrix, telemetry, operational notes and rollback, so support and launch work has one place to look instead of reading source.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Worker blob/double slot mapping
nodes.rationale: Analytics Engine writes fixed slots (index1/blob1 = event name, blob2..7 = mode/path/method/dateKind/outcome/cellKind, double1..6 = dateAge/scoreBucket/bestScoreBucket/attemptIndex/attemptsUsed/days). Every saved query depends on this mapping, so it is documented once in the queries README.

nodes.label: modesPlayed dropped at the Worker level
nodes.rationale: The Phase 4 daily_shared event carries modesPlayed but the Worker has no blob slot for it, so dashboards break shares down by method only. Surfaced (not fixed) to keep the PR tight and deferred to the v1.1 roadmap.
nodes.norm_label: modesplayed dropped at the worker level

nodes.label: Version-controlled Analytics Engine saved queries
nodes.rationale: Cloudflare exposes no dashboards-as-code API for Analytics Engine, so the .sql files plus a README are committed and the dashboard layout itself stays manual.

nodes.label: Automated keyboard-only smoke spec
nodes.rationale: The golden path (launcher, streak pill, history panel, calendar arrows, reveal) is automatable; the subjective question 'does Tab order match visual order' is not, so the manual pass stays on the launch checklist. Tests assert reachability within N presses rather than an exact Tab count.

nodes.label: Human launch checklist + 72h monitor
nodes.rationale: Everything requiring a browser-UI click (CF dashboard building, NVDA pass, Sentry alert rules, monitor configuration) is captured as a checklist inside the system doc for a human to execute post-merge, keeping the PR fully automatable.

nodes.label: Retention v1 rollback procedure
nodes.rationale: Surfaces are purely client-side on GitHub Pages, so a git revert republishes automatically; the Worker rolls back separately via wrangler and is usually unnecessary because it accepts forward-compatible event shapes.

nodes.label: 00:00 UTC daily rollover timezone lag
nodes.rationale: Accepted known limitation for v1: users up to +14h east of UTC may see 'yesterday' past their local midnight; per-timezone rollover deferred to v1.1.

nodes.label: 14-day analytics baseline launch gate
nodes.rationale: Code lands immediately but the launch announcement and 72h monitor wait until 14 days of events have accumulated, so anomaly detection has something to compare against.

nodes.label: Retention v1 Phase 3 — Streak + Calendar + Reveal Plan
nodes.norm_label: retention v1 phase 3 — streak + calendar + reveal plan

nodes.label: calendarGrid pure 5x7 grid helper
nodes.rationale: Returns a fixed 35-cell Monday-aligned array ending on the current ISO-week Sunday so the component does zero date math of its own. Cell count stays constant at 35 even if the retention window shrinks — older cells simply render rolled-off. Future cells inside the current week are also marked rolled-off so they do not look playable.

nodes.label: pendingMilestone derived-not-persisted milestone detection
nodes.rationale: Milestone eligibility is computed from streak.current vs streak.lastMilestoneShown instead of being written at streak-update time, which keeps updateStreak pure. markMilestoneShown is the only writer, giving once-per-threshold dedupe.

nodes.label: LauncherStreakPill (active / broken / first states)
nodes.rationale: Takes a streakMode prop rather than deriving from current===0, because updateStreak never sets current to 0 (its else branch resets to 1). A stale streak therefore has current>=1 with an old lastActiveDate, so 'broken' must be derived at render time from lastActiveDate vs yesterday. A data-streak-mode attribute makes the state e2e-assertable without matching copy.

nodes.label: LauncherMilestoneOverlay
nodes.rationale: Celebrates thresholds 3/7/14/30/100, fires streak_reached_milestone on mount, auto-dismisses at 2500ms and is click/Escape dismissible; the whole overlay is a button so the accessible name computation works and aria-live announces it.

nodes.label: LauncherHistoryPanel calendar panel
nodes.rationale: Arrow-key navigation is handled once at the panel level by reading the focused cell's data-testid and moving +/-1 or +/-7, rather than each cell tracking its own neighbours.

nodes.label: LauncherCalendarCell with per-mode dots
nodes.rationale: Rolled-off cells are disabled with tabIndex -1 so only interactive cells enter the tab order; the colour dots are aria-hidden and the mode coverage is carried in the cell's aria-label instead.

nodes.label: DailyRevealOverlay (text-only reveal)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately does no map manipulation: MapLibre camera state is tied to GameController's session, so decoupling the reveal from the session keeps the PR scoped. Renders target name plus stored attempts as an emoji dot strip; a map-based reveal is left to a future PR.

nodes.label: scoreDot score-to-emoji bucketing
nodes.rationale: Maps a 0-100 attempt score to one of five coloured squares with the numeric score kept as the aria-label, so emoji is never the sole carrier of meaning.

nodes.label: Nested Escape cascade (panel before launcher)
nodes.rationale: Escape closes the history panel first and stops propagation so it does not also dismiss the launcher; the focus-trap effect re-binds on historyOpen so the handler sees fresh state through its closure.

nodes.label: GameController already-played / past-date reveal redirect
nodes.rationale: Symmetric gate: future dates go to root, past dates or an already-played mode redirect to the matching /reveal URL instead of restarting the session, so a shared or bookmarked link never silently replays a finished daily.

nodes.label: 'See reveal' CTA via deep-link navigation
nodes.rationale: Sets window.location.hash rather than opening a modal from the launcher, so the played-card CTA goes through the identical hashchange flow as typing the URL directly — one code path, not two.

nodes.label: PlayedResult.countryName renamed to targetName
nodes.rationale: The field holds a country name in country mode and a city name in city mode, so the Phase 2 name was misleading.

nodes.label: Guardian Open Platform build-time news pipeline
nodes.rationale: No runtime backend: a daily GitHub Action iterates all 249 countries, queries content.guardianapis.com/search by world/<country> tag, tops up to five stories from the Guardian region tag, and commits static per-country JSON under public/news/. The client only fetches a static file.
nodes.norm_label: guardian open platform build-time news pipeline

nodes.label: Guardian region-tag fallback
nodes.rationale: Small countries rarely have five country-tagged stories in a 7-day window, so results are topped up from world/africa, world/americas, world/asia-pacific, world/europe or world/middleeast and badged as region scope so the user can tell them apart.

nodes.label: sanitise() HTML strip + entity decode
nodes.rationale: Guardian trailText is HTML; tags are stripped and named/numeric/hex entities decoded at build time so the client never renders third-party markup.

nodes.label: Hand-curated cca3 to Guardian tag lookup
nodes.rationale: Seeded with roughly 40 major countries and null for the rest — an accepted maintenance burden that later became one of the arguments for migrating off Guardian.
nodes.norm_label: hand-curated cca3 to guardian tag lookup

nodes.label: CountryNewsSection panel component
nodes.rationale: Fetches the per-country JSON on panel open and is gated on !inGameRound so news never leaks into a guess phase.

nodes.label: relativeTime hand-rolled formatter
nodes.rationale: Hand-rolled with bucket-boundary unit tests rather than adding a date library, keeping the zero-new-dependency constraint.

nodes.label: GUARDIAN_KEY secret + rotation procedure
nodes.rationale: Requires a human pre-flight step (register a developer key, add it as a GitHub Actions secret); if absent the initial data commit is skipped and clients see 'News unavailable' until the first scheduled run.

nodes.label: Country-news feature removal (PR #40, 2026-05-12)
nodes.rationale: Tombstoned 2026-06-12: the country-news feature was removed in PR #40, so both the Guardian plan and its GDELT successor are history-only.

nodes.label: Country-Pinning Guess-Phase Fixes + Round-End UX Plan
nodes.norm_label: country-pinning guess-phase fixes + round-end ux plan

nodes.label: SingleCountryPanel inGameRound prop
nodes.rationale: One prop reuses the existing country panel as the round-end reveal surface — hiding Compare and Copy-link and swapping the close icon for a Continue text button — instead of building a second panel component.

nodes.label: Tooltip identity suppression during guess phase
nodes.rationale: The hover tooltip was leaking the country name during a country-pinning guess, making the game trivially winnable; the fix reads game state via useGameSessionContext and blanks the identity content only in that phase.
nodes.norm_label: tooltip identity suppression during guess phase

nodes.label: GuessByNameButton deletion
nodes.rationale: Guess-by-name defeated the spatial premise of the game; the component and its render block were removed outright rather than hidden behind a flag.

nodes.label: Asymmetric round-end advance (correct auto, wrong continue-required)
nodes.rationale: Replaces a fixed auto-advance with outcome-dependent pacing: a correct guess auto-advances after 3000ms and is skippable by key, a wrong guess sets no timer at all so the player can study the reveal and must press Continue or Escape.
nodes.norm_label: asymmetric round-end advance (correct auto, wrong continue-required)

nodes.label: Guardian to GDELT News Source Migration Plan
nodes.norm_label: guardian to gdelt news source migration plan

nodes.label: GDELT 2.0 Doc API news source
nodes.rationale: Chosen to make the news feature commercial-use compatible (the Guardian free key is non-commercial only) and to delete three sources of ongoing work at once: no API key, no hand-curated per-country tag list, no region fallback. Query operators were verified against live GDELT (locationcc: not location:, sourcelang:english not :eng).

nodes.label: cca3 to FIPS-10-4 code mapping
nodes.rationale: GDELT keys locations by FIPS-10-4 rather than ISO. Roughly 210 of 249 FIPS codes equal the cca2, so the module is an override table of the ~40 divergent codes with cca2 as the fallback — far smaller to maintain than a full table, and validated by a one-off dry run.

nodes.label: Deletion of Guardian-specific modules
nodes.rationale: guardian-client, guardian-tags and regions are removed in the same change as the GDELT rewrite so no dead ingestion path survives the migration.

nodes.label: Per-country news JSON output shape
nodes.rationale: The static contract between the build pipeline and CountryNewsSection: title, source domain, publish time and thumbnail — the client renders only what the file carries, so a pipeline swap needs no client protocol change beyond field names.

nodes.label: Animated Reveal + Mobile Tap + Playwright Coverage Plan
nodes.norm_label: animated reveal + mobile tap + playwright coverage plan

nodes.label: slerpLngLat great-circle interpolation
nodes.rationale: Spherical interpolation keeps the guess-to-target line on a great circle so the dashed reveal reads as a real distance on the globe rather than a straight screen-space segment.

nodes.label: computeRevealAnimationPlan pure helper
nodes.rationale: All reveal geometry and timing is computed as a plain data plan by a pure function so it is unit-testable in jsdom; the requestAnimationFrame loop in GameController only replays the plan frame by frame.

nodes.label: MapLibre clickTolerance mobile tap fix
nodes.rationale: A one-line constructor config: finger jitter during a tap exceeded MapLibre's default click tolerance so touches were classified as drags and never became guesses (the Italy tap bug).

nodes.label: 4px bbox widening on queryRenderedFeatures
nodes.rationale: Complements the clickTolerance fix: hit-testing a small box instead of a single pixel makes taps near a thin border resolve to the intended country.

nodes.label: Playwright mobile/touch project matrix
nodes.rationale: mobile-chromium, mobile-webkit and desktop-firefox-touch projects were added specifically so the tap fix has a regression home; the matrix doc records which specs run under which project and which manual QA stays out of CI scope.

nodes.label: Reduced-motion reveal path
nodes.rationale: prefers-reduced-motion skips the animated line draw and jumps straight to the end state, with its own e2e spec so the branch cannot silently rot.

nodes.label: waitForTimeout(N) anti-pattern
nodes.rationale: Sleeping a magic number of milliseconds is wallclock-non-deterministic on shared CI runners; it passes locally and flakes in CI. Identified as the direct cause of seven known flakes and swept out of eight spec files.

nodes.label: Five state-based wait replacement patterns
nodes.rationale: Codifying a small closed set of replacements (auto-retrying assertion, not.toBeAttached, expect.poll on a seam, etc.) meant every sleep site had a named target rather than a bespoke rewrite.

nodes.label: CI-aware per-project timing defaults
nodes.rationale: GPU-dependent projects get a generous budget under CI (120s test, 15s assertion polling, 20s action) while local runs stay tight, so a slow runner does not manifest as a fake failure and a local regression is still caught quickly.

nodes.label: Three-consecutive-green CI gate
nodes.rationale: A single green run cannot distinguish a fixed flake from a lucky one, so the deflake work is only declared done after repeated consecutive green runs.

nodes.label: Security Hardening + Reveal Camera + Tutorial Click Fix Plan
nodes.norm_label: security hardening + reveal camera + tutorial click fix plan

nodes.label: GDELT URL protocol allowlist
nodes.rationale: Defense-in-depth at the ingestion boundary: article URLs from a third-party feed are filtered to an http/https allowlist during the build so a javascript: or data: URL can never reach a rendered anchor.

nodes.label: VITE_TEST_HOOKS test-seam stripping from production
nodes.rationale: A dedicated Vite mode (--mode e2e) sets VITE_TEST_HOOKS=1 so __funworldmap_* seams are tree-shaken out of the production bundle while Playwright keeps full introspection. Verified by grepping the built bundle for the seam names rather than trusting the flag.

nodes.label: Tutorial dismisses on first attempt
nodes.rationale: The first-session tutorial overlay was swallowing the player's opening click; a firstAttemptMade prop dismisses it on the first guess instead of requiring a separate dismissal interaction.

nodes.label: Per-frame reveal camera follows the line head
nodes.rationale: fitBounds over-zoomed on long guess-to-target distances; replaced with a jumpTo to the wrong-guess centroid at t=0 plus a per-frame jumpTo to the current arc point inside the existing rAF loop, with a matching jumpTo for the reduced-motion path. The now-unused fitPadding helper was deleted in the same change.
nodes.norm_label: per-frame reveal camera follows the line head

nodes.label: recordAttempt/submitGuess collapse into one attempt action
nodes.rationale: The split between recordAttempt and submitGuess let callers dispatch half a state transition; collapsing to a single attempt action makes the reducer the sole owner of attempt sequencing and unblocks the resume, feedback and telemetry commits that follow.
nodes.norm_label: recordattempt/submitguess collapse into one attempt action

nodes.label: In-progress daily attempt resume persistence
nodes.rationale: Refresh mid-daily used to be destructive — attempts were lost with no way to replay the once-per-day puzzle. Attempts are written per-attempt and read on both the immediate and deferred hash-bootstrap paths; forfeiting via Escape clears the resume record so quitting stays intentional.

nodes.label: deep_link_opened single fire-point redesign
nodes.rationale: The event was fired from App.tsx, DailyRevealOverlay and useSelectedCountry, producing duplicates and inconsistent props; all fires were deleted in favour of one point in the GameController bootstrap, and free_started moved there too.

nodes.label: Done button + completeNow wiring
nodes.rationale: Gives the player an explicit way to end a best-of-N run early instead of being forced to spend every attempt.

nodes.label: Personal-bests storage key v2 migration
nodes.rationale: Bumping the key plus pruneOlderThan and gating the daily leak stopped daily scores contaminating free-play personal bests in already-shipped browsers.

nodes.label: dailyRound returns null on pool miss
nodes.rationale: A daily index entry naming a country absent from the bundled pool previously produced an undefined target mid-game; returning null lets the caller fall back cleanly.
nodes.norm_label: dailyround returns null on pool miss

nodes.label: Drop the playing flag from HashState
nodes.rationale: Removes a second, redundant source of truth for whether a game is in progress — session state already knows.
nodes.norm_label: drop the playing flag from hashstate

nodes.label: Module-level store via useSyncExternalStore
nodes.rationale: Three critical bugs (missing share block, stale share data, cross-mode PB contamination) had one root cause: useDailyHistory and usePersonalBests each ran a local useState initializer reading localStorage once per hook instance, so two consumers held independent state and writes never propagated. The fix is one pattern — module-level snapshot plus listener set exposed as subscribe/getSnapshot/mutators — with the hook public APIs kept identical so no caller changes.

nodes.label: Freeze beatPersonalBest at first paint
nodes.rationale: The store refactor makes the post-record() re-render MORE reliable, which makes the 'New PB!' flash worse rather than better — the overlay must additionally freeze the value in useState(initial) so it does not flip once the new best lands.

nodes.label: Personal bests hidden on daily game-over
nodes.rationale: A daily result is a fixed one-shot puzzle, so comparing it to a free-play personal best is meaningless and was also the vector for PB contamination.
nodes.norm_label: personal bests hidden on daily game-over

nodes.label: Running best-of-N score in the HUD
nodes.rationale: Players could not see what they were currently scoring mid-run; surfacing the running best makes the Done button a decision rather than a guess.
nodes.norm_label: running best-of-n score in the hud

nodes.label: Mode switch from game-over via direct URL
nodes.rationale: The bootstrap refused to start a new session while in game-over, so navigating to the other mode's URL dead-ended on the finished overlay.
nodes.norm_label: mode switch from game-over via direct url

nodes.label: dailyDate field on GameSession
nodes.rationale: window.location.hash was being used as the oracle for 'is this a daily?', so a single ocean or off-globe click that cleared the hash produced a six-symptom cascade. dailyDate is threaded through the start and resume actions and read at the three call sites (resume write, game-over recording, GameOverOverlay) that previously re-parsed the hash.

nodes.label: clickMap deselect gating during gameplay
nodes.rationale: Defense-in-depth alongside the dailyDate fix: off-target clicks during gameplay no longer clear the URL hash at all, so even a future hash-reading regression cannot be triggered by an ocean tap.

nodes.label: finishFree reducer action
nodes.rationale: Free-play End-game needed a distinct transition from the daily path; onEndGame branches on session.dailyDate to pick between them.

nodes.label: Clear stale aria-live region after each announcement
nodes.rationale: A live region left populated re-announces stale text on the next screen-reader traversal; clearing it after each announcement (and dropping a redundant duplicate round-end block) keeps announcements one-to-one with events.
nodes.norm_label: clear stale aria-live region after each announcement

nodes.label: subscribeReducedMotion mid-session toggle support
nodes.rationale: prefers-reduced-motion was read once at mount, so a user toggling it mid-session kept the old behaviour; a subscription API plus useMapInstance re-applying pitch on change makes the preference live.

nodes.label: endOfRound always returns 'round-ended'
nodes.rationale: The reducer returned 'game-over' directly whenever endsGame was true, but the whole reveal pipeline is gated on 'round-ended' — so every daily and every kill-shot free round skipped the reveal animation entirely. Making the transition uniform restores the reveal without adding a new session field, since endsGame already lives on lastOutcome.

nodes.label: finalize reducer action
nodes.rationale: Moves round-ended to game-over only once the controller's reveal animation completes, so the animation owns the timing rather than the reducer.

nodes.label: Reveal spoiler protection for unplayed modes
nodes.rationale: The reveal route showed today's answer for a mode the visitor had not yet played, spoiling their own puzzle; the headline is hidden for unplayed modes on the current date.
nodes.norm_label: reveal spoiler protection for unplayed modes

nodes.label: endedEarly flag + accurate game-over copy
nodes.rationale: Ending a run via Done produced the same copy as exhausting all attempts, misreporting what the player did.

nodes.label: Reset lastMilestoneShown on streak break
nodes.rationale: Without a reset, a user who broke a 30-day streak and rebuilt it would never see the 3/7/14 celebrations again, because the dedupe watermark stayed high.

nodes.label: +0 score toast suppression
nodes.rationale: Celebrating a zero-point attempt with a score chip reads as mockery; the toast is suppressed when nothing was earned.

nodes.label: daily_attempted.attemptIndex made 1-based
nodes.rationale: Code emitted 0-based indices while the telemetry documentation promised 1|2|3, so dashboards silently mislabelled attempts.

nodes.label: Round-start announcement gated on round-key transition
nodes.rationale: Re-announcing on every render rather than on an actual round change spammed screen readers.
nodes.norm_label: round-start announcement gated on round-key transition

nodes.label: Chromium project consolidation (drop Software ANGLE)
nodes.rationale: The separate Software-ANGLE chromium project was the documented largest contributor to the flake regression; collapsing it into the real-GPU-capable project removed the slow backend and an eight-minute redundant CI job at the same time.

nodes.label: click({ force: true }) anti-pattern
nodes.rationale: force:true skips Playwright's visible/enabled/stable checks, papering over the real problem — an overlay, animation or portal still in transition. When a force click is needed, the occluder's timing is the actual bug, so every site is replaced with a wait for the occluder to detach.

nodes.label: data-animation-state component signal
nodes.rationale: Components that stay mounted through their animation cannot be waited on with not.toBeAttached, so they expose entering|idle|exiting. Driven by Element.getAnimations({subtree:true}) so no duration is hand-typed on either the component or the test side.

nodes.label: waitForAnimationIdle(locator) e2e helper
nodes.rationale: Gives tests one canonical call for CSS-transition timing, and the CLAUDE.md update makes it the documented replacement for waitForTimeout so new tests do not reintroduce the pattern.

nodes.label: 2026-04-28 flake regression analysis
nodes.rationale: Documents why the earlier deflake fix did not hold: it was load-time-only (data-app-ready), per-test sleeps and force clicks were never removed, and later PRs copied the same patterns until cumulative flake exceeded CI tolerance.

nodes.label: Toast z-index raised above modal overlays
nodes.rationale: Toast rendered at z-50 while modals sit at z-[210], so any toast dispatched over a modal was invisible behind its backdrop. This single finding explained the audit's unresolved 'share button gives no feedback' report — dispatchToast('Copied!') was firing all along.
nodes.norm_label: toast z-index raised above modal overlays

nodes.label: Single z-stack constants module
nodes.rationale: Preferred over a one-off number bump so a future modal cannot accidentally out-z-index the Toast again.

nodes.label: Daily-card copy: three states, not one
nodes.rationale: loading, fetch-failed and ready-but-today-missing all collapsed into one 'Today's daily is syncing.' string. Splitting the discriminated union lets each state say something actionable, including a CTA to the most recent available date derived from index.window.end.
nodes.norm_label: daily-card copy: three states, not one

nodes.label: Compare A/B distinct map-highlight colours
nodes.rationale: Panel badges were coral/teal but both compared countries painted the same red on the map. The fix belongs in mapLayers paint properties, not useSelectionHighlight, which only sets filters — a source-pointer correction found during plan review.

nodes.label: Cloudflare RUM gated to production builds
nodes.rationale: Two CORS errors per dev page load were drowning real console signal; wrapping the script in import.meta.env.PROD drops it from the dev bundle entirely.
nodes.norm_label: cloudflare rum gated to production builds

nodes.label: Launcher initial-focus a11y guard
nodes.rationale: Naively re-running the focus effect when puzzlesStatus becomes ready would steal focus from a user who tabbed away during loading, so the effect only re-focuses if activeElement is still the loading placeholder. Fixing the original bug without this guard would introduce a different a11y bug.

nodes.label: Dark-mode map label contrast 2.44:1
nodes.rationale: Runtime sampling of MapLibre text-color and text-halo-color turned a subjective audit claim into a measured 2.44:1 against a 3:1 minimum — and the measurement spec was deliberately converted to collect-not-fail so verification reports data instead of blocking CI.

nodes.label: Source review applies to plans, not just findings
nodes.rationale: Meta-lesson from Revision 2: roughly thirty minutes of reading the actual source produced six edits to the plan — one new finding (toast z-index), two corrected file pointers, one new a11y guard, one simplified approach and one elevated risk. Vision shows symptoms; source review shows causes, and that applies to the plan itself.
nodes.norm_label: source review applies to plans, not just findings

nodes.label: Quick wins to verification to major fixes sequencing
nodes.rationale: Verification is placed before the major fixes because its results can re-scope them, with an explicit stakeholder checkpoint between the two phases; each phase carries its own definition of done.
nodes.norm_label: quick wins to verification to major fixes sequencing

nodes.label: Tiered subagent review rigor
nodes.rationale: Honest execution-log admission: formal review was skipped for two single-line changes and got lucky. Proposed correction is explicit tiers — trivial gets controller-only, moderate gets one combined review, substantive gets full implementer plus spec plus code-quality review — rather than an unstated case-by-case call.

nodes.label: Chromium e2e flake triage Implementation Plan
nodes.norm_label: chromium e2e flake triage implementation plan

nodes.label: Evidence-driven flake fixing (no blanket timeout bumps)
nodes.rationale: Residual flakes are resolved by pulling CI traces and naming a root cause per failure, because blanket timeout increases and test rewrites both violate the repository's e2e rules and hide the assumption the test is actually making.
nodes.norm_label: evidence-driven flake fixing (no blanket timeout bumps)

nodes.label: dismissLauncher waitForTimeout replaced with Header-attached wait
nodes.rationale: The project's last remaining sleep lived in a shared helper, so one fix removed the pattern from every spec that called it.
nodes.norm_label: dismisslauncher waitfortimeout replaced with header-attached wait

nodes.label: routeMapTilesRich vs live basemap request investigation
nodes.rationale: Before choosing between dropping and extending the rich tile stub, the plan requires establishing what the stub actually fulfils versus what the light-theme positron basemap requests at runtime — the fix branches on that evidence rather than being pre-committed.
nodes.norm_label: routemaptilesrich vs live basemap request investigation

nodes.label: panel-focus flake — three competing hypotheses
nodes.rationale: Stale closure in the effect, mount-time race, or genuine CI slowness lead to different fixes (component-side vs test-side), so the CI trace is pulled to discriminate before any code changes.

nodes.label: Five-consecutive-green CI watch as the done gate
nodes.rationale: An observational phase with a run log; flake work is not declared complete on a single pass because intermittent failures are by definition survivable once.
nodes.norm_label: five-consecutive-green ci watch as the done gate

nodes.label: Fix Daily Pipelines + Verified Code Bugs Plan
nodes.norm_label: fix daily pipelines + verified code bugs plan

nodes.label: workflow_run deploy trigger for content pipelines
nodes.rationale: The content-generation workflow committed fresh data but nothing redeployed the site, so production served stale content from 2026-05-07 onward. Adding a workflow_run trigger closes the loop; the diagnosis is confirmed by manually dispatching the content workflow and watching whether deploy fires.
nodes.norm_label: workflow_run deploy trigger for content pipelines

nodes.label: News pipeline dropped (decided 2026-05-12)
nodes.rationale: Rather than repair a persistently failing ingestion pipeline, the feature it fed was removed — deciding the fate of the pipeline was explicitly framed as a decision the plan had to make, not a repair it had to perform.

nodes.label: Reduced-motion bypass on game start
nodes.rationale: The start path animated the camera regardless of the user's prefers-reduced-motion setting, so the preference was honoured everywhere except the first thing a player saw.

nodes.label: Sentry breadcrumbs in daily-storage swallow-catches
nodes.rationale: localStorage failures were caught and silently discarded, so quota or private-mode errors were invisible in production. Breadcrumbs keep the catch non-fatal while making the failure observable.

nodes.label: Cold-load #game/<mode> deep-link regression test
nodes.rationale: Deep links were only exercised after an in-app navigation, leaving the cold-load bootstrap path untested.

nodes.label: Production health smoke check
nodes.rationale: Validating the live site after the pipeline fix is what turns 'the workflow is green' into 'production is actually current' — the stale-content incident went unnoticed precisely because CI was green.

nodes.label: Share-button branch e2e coverage
nodes.rationale: Unit tests covered the navigator.share, clipboard and error branches but could not prove the toast actually rendered end to end; the e2e specs drive the branches through the existing window.__PLAYWRIGHT__ analytics seam rather than stubbing fetch.

nodes.label: Animation interrupt coverage (4 cases)
nodes.rationale: Rapid Continue, Escape mid-reveal, Escape mid-panel-slide-in and hash mutation mid-animation had no coverage. The tests key on data-animation-state="entering" instead of wall-clock timing, so they assert the interrupt happens genuinely mid-animation without sleeping.

nodes.label: Playwright MCP state-signaled visual verification
nodes.rationale: Visual polish cannot be asserted by a test, so screenshots are captured at state-signaled frames and reconciled against the documented unhappy-path scenarios, with a scope guardrail limiting in-line fixes to trivial deviations.

nodes.label: Coverage gaps that held ratings below 9
nodes.rationale: The plan is scoped precisely to the two gaps the 2026-05-11 assessment named, rather than a general coverage push — the assessment's rating is the acceptance criterion.
nodes.norm_label: coverage gaps that held ratings below 9

nodes.label: GameController Extraction Plan
nodes.rationale: One plan with five phases rather than five plans: the five extractions share state ownership (all read useGameSessionContext session + dispatchers) and a single physical source file, so splitting would force each plan to re-establish the same characterization-test methodology, file-map decisions, and deferral list, and would lose the safest-first ordering rationale that only makes sense as one document.

nodes.label: useGameTestSeams hook
nodes.rationale: Chosen as the safest first extraction: the effect only registers/unregisters keys on window.__funworldmap_game when VITE_TEST_HOOKS is truthy, so in production builds the body is a no-op — zero production-regression risk — while e2e failures would be a loud signal.

nodes.label: useDailyResumePersistence hook
nodes.rationale: Safe second because it is a single concern (one useEffect, one localStorage key) whose guards are pure expressions over session — no timers, no map state, no animations — with the failure mode contained to the daily resume feature already covered by e2e/daily-best-of-3.spec.ts.

nodes.label: useGameAnnouncements hook
nodes.rationale: Third-safest: touches the screen-reader live region, auto-advance timers, and personal-best/daily-history recording — all reducer-state-driven with no MapLibre coupling, no map paint, no rAF, no hash routing.

nodes.label: useRevealMapEffects hook
nodes.rationale: Riskier because it drives the reveal layer (paint properties, geodesic arc rAF loop), intermediate-reveal flashes, camera reset on round start, city-mode any-click handler, and idle-state reveal clear — GPU/animation coupling plus App.tsx touch-points on session.lastOutcome.reveal.

nodes.label: useHashGameRouter hook
nodes.rationale: Extracted last because it is the most tangled: parses the location hash, drives initial bootstrap, listens to hashchange, drains deferred starts once pools arrive, emits deep_link_opened analytics and daily_attempted telemetry, and owns four refs plus the statusRef other hooks consume.

nodes.label: Characterization-test methodology
nodes.rationale: Write the test FIRST against the current inlined behaviour so it PASSES on main; then extract; then re-run the same test via renderHook against the new hook. If the test still passes, behaviour is preserved. A test that fails on main signals either a separate bug or a misunderstood spec — stop before extracting.

nodes.label: src/game/hooks/ directory convention
nodes.rationale: src/hooks/ is the app-shell hook home (map, country/city data, theme, search) so game hooks would be out of place there; src/game/shared/ hosts the session core (reducer, provider, personal bests) and mixing five effect-only hooks in would blur shape. Option C (src/game/GameController/index.tsx) was rejected because a file move breaks every existing import — blast radius outweighs the organisational win.

nodes.label: Nine useRef mirrors of reducer state
nodes.rationale: The 9 useRef mirrors of reducer state get re-homed into the hooks that own them rather than eliminated. The ref-mirror code smell is real (it is the closure-staleness site behind bug #32), but replacing it via useSyncExternalStore or commit-driven patterns is a separate architectural refactor, explicitly out of scope for this extraction.
nodes.norm_label: nine useref mirrors of reducer state

nodes.label: CI testIgnore + quarantine interaction risk
nodes.rationale: game-country-pinning.spec.ts sits in CI's testIgnore list, so CI alone cannot validate phases 3-5 — the spec must be run locally. Five tests are quarantined via test.fixme(!!process.env.CI) under issues #31/#32/#47, and the extractions interact with all three: if a quarantined test starts passing locally the underlying fix may have landed as a side effect; if it fails harder, revisit the extraction.

nodes.label: App.tsx coupling to GameController
nodes.rationale: App.tsx reads session.lastOutcome.reveal.targetCca3, dispatches advance/finalize, branches on session.modeId, and runs a second hashchange subscriber that duplicates the router. If an extracted hook changes the shape or timing of any field App.tsx reads, the parallel App.tsx update must land in the SAME PR as the extraction, not a follow-up.

nodes.label: Tier-1 Continuation Plan
nodes.rationale: Four independent subsystems (a11y, asset/perf, CI infra, architecture brainstorming) kept as one plan because each is too small to justify its own; phase order is recommended but not load-bearing except Phase 3 which must follow Phase 2.

nodes.label: Panel-open focus management (a11y)
nodes.rationale: docs/systems/accessibility.md:91 promised focus moves to the panel heading when the country panel opens, but SingleCountryPanel had a panelRootRef with no .focus() call — a real WCAG 2.4.3 bug leaving screen-reader users with no announcement. Fix: tabIndex={-1} + headingRef focused inside a requestAnimationFrame so the DOM commits before focus moves.

nodes.label: countries-10m to countries-50m chunk swap
nodes.rationale: The async countries chunk had drifted to 954 KB gzip; world-atlas countries-50m.json is ~4.8x smaller than 10m. The visual-fidelity tradeoff (missing small island states rendered as synthetic 1deg squares) was accepted per 2026-05-14 user decision because the polygons are still clickable, which is what gameplay needs. Abort rule: if more than 5 canonical IDs are missing, the patching effort is not worth it and 10m stays.

nodes.label: missingCountriesPatch synthetic geometry
nodes.rationale: Synthesizes a tiny square polygon around each missing entity's centroid. Geographic accuracy is irrelevant — the polygon only needs to be clickable so queryRenderedFeatures returns the feature ID, keeping every canonical-195 country present without ballooning the bundle back to 10m.

nodes.label: Bundle-size budget CI gate
nodes.rationale: The 2026-05-11 audit found the real bundle was 2x the documented budget (710 KB documented vs 1,461 KB measured). Budgets set to measured+10%: the headroom prevents trivial-cause flake (a new icon adding 200 bytes) while still catching real regressions. Raising a budget requires measurement evidence in the commit message. Must be sequenced after the 50m swap because the numbers derive from post-swap sizes.

nodes.label: playwright-matrix.md refresh
nodes.rationale: The matrix was two doc-revisions stale: it still showed the chromium/chromium-gpu split consolidated on 2026-05-02 when Software ANGLE was dropped, omitted four newer specs, and documented neither the 13-spec CI testIgnore list nor the 5 test.fixme quarantines (#31, #32, #47).

nodes.label: GameController extraction brainstorm (Phase 4 deliverable)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately produces a plan, not code: GameController.tsx is 833 lines with 9 ref-mirrors and comments referencing bug #32 (closure-staleness, two-render race), flagged by the 2026-05-11 audit as the largest single architectural risk and the most likely site of the next regression.

nodes.label: Repository Cleanup & Presentability Plan (v5)
nodes.rationale: The repo is internally rigorous and externally underdeveloped: a visitor sees no demo, screenshot, or CI badges, so the project's real maturity is obscured. Seven phases sequenced by visible-impact-per-cost; keeping diagnosis adjacent to prescription is why it is one plan rather than seven.

nodes.label: Working-tree hygiene sweep
nodes.rationale: 16 untracked files persisted across a multi-day session — a 9.5 MB corrupt lightningcss .bak, 9 abandoned dev screenshots, and three completed plan files that should have been archived. .gitignore grows /share-*.png and /.tmp-*/ so the same classes cannot re-accumulate.

nodes.label: Presentation polish (README, metadata, governance)
nodes.rationale: package.json keeps private:true and version 0.0.0 (correct for an unpublished GitHub-Pages app — prevents accidental npm publish) but gains license/description/homepage/repository/keywords. Adds CODE_OF_CONDUCT, issue/PR templates, CodeQL workflow, and a freshly generated hero screenshot; OSSF Scorecard was declined by the user.

nodes.label: Test-fixture consolidation
nodes.rationale: Surfaced by the five /simplify passes during the GameController extraction: Window.__funworldmap_game re-cast inline at 3 production sites with no shared declare global, __testAnalytics redeclared at 5 sites, makeCountryReveal/makePointReveal/makeOutcome byte-identical across two hook test files, and three separate implementations of makeFakeMap.

nodes.label: modePredicates — stringly-typed mode-ID comparisons
nodes.rationale: 36 stringly-typed mode-ID comparisons (re-verified firsthand; previous estimate 23), worst offender useHashGameRouter.ts with 5+ sites. ModeId is a string union so TypeScript catches typos, but the literal-string sites pile up — at this count the user promoted predicate helpers from optional to REQUIRED.

nodes.label: Reveal-color semantic constants
nodes.rationale: 10 inline hex codes in useRevealMapEffects plus 3 more in its test encode three semantic colors (#22c55e correct, #f59e0b warn, #ef4444 far) with no named constants; mapPalette.ts exists but carries only the TEAL/CORAL brand family, so reveal feedback has no home.

nodes.label: Nine ref-mirrors across the five extracted hooks
nodes.rationale: statusRef, pendingStartRef, lastRevealEmitHashRef, lastAttemptCountRef, prevStatusForTelemetryRef, recordedRef, lastAnnouncedRoundKeyRef, lastIntermediateAttemptCountRef, prevStatusForIntermediateRef — documented out-of-scope in the GameController extraction plan; replacement via useSyncExternalStore is a separate architectural refactor. eslint-plugin-react-hooks 7.1's stricter ref validation may surface new findings against them.
nodes.norm_label: nine ref-mirrors across the five extracted hooks

nodes.label: Tooling tier-up (typecheck script, husky, editorconfig, type-checked ESLint)
nodes.rationale: Type-checking only happened implicitly via tsc -b inside build; no pre-commit hooks meant avoidable CI noise from formatting/lint failures; no .editorconfig left indent/EOL to IDE plugins. The ESLint recommended-type-checked ruleset was deferred earlier because it surfaces many findings that must be fixed first.
nodes.norm_label: tooling tier-up (typecheck script, husky, editorconfig, type-checked eslint)

nodes.label: Dependency hygiene phase
nodes.rationale: Substantial major-version lag (jsdom 4 majors, eslint-plugin-react-hooks 2, typescript/eslint 1 each) reframed as a maintainability cost rather than a CVE risk. Sequenced after Phase 4 so the ESLint 10 bump and the type-checked ruleset land together. @vitejs/plugin-react and Vite bumps explicitly deferred: plugin-react v5+ requires Vite 8+ and the repo is on Vite 6.4.2, so 4.7.0 is the newest compatible. Dependabot config added so the lag cannot silently re-accumulate.

nodes.label: Quarantined e2e tests triage
nodes.rationale: 5 tests across 3 issues: animation-interrupt x3 (#47, animation state unobservable under CI reduced-motion baseline), game-over-mode-switch (#32, timeout-dependent mode switch), launcher (#31, compositor frame production / ANGLE renderer flake). All honest test.fixme quarantines with issue links; the underlying causes remain unresolved and the phase may be blocked on GPU-runner availability.

nodes.label: Camera Coherence Plan
nodes.rationale: Make the camera obey one rule — preserve the user's view on every game lifecycle event (start, round advance, end); the reveal animation is the only place the camera intentionally moves. Four independently revertable commits.

nodes.label: Preserve-the-user's-view camera rule
nodes.rationale: Two flyTo(DEFAULT_*) effects (App-level game-start and the reveal hook's round-start) yanked the camera away from wherever the user had navigated. Deleting both makes one coherent rule instead of per-lifecycle-event exceptions; the round-start flyTo test is rewritten as an anti-test asserting flyTo is NOT called on game start.

nodes.label: line-gradient reveal animation
nodes.rationale: Replaces the per-frame setData + jumpTo rAF loop with a one-shot full-arc setData plus a single easeTo camera and per-frame setPaintProperty('line-gradient'), using lineMetrics:true and line-progress. Moves per-frame cost off geometry rebuilds and onto a paint property, which the GPU already interpolates.
nodes.community_name: line-gradient reveal animation + Reveal-artifact cleanup on round transition

nodes.label: initialCameraView property removal
nodes.rationale: Once both camera resets are deleted, the per-mode initialCameraView ('preserve' for country-pinning, 'world' for city-guessing) and the mode parameter on useRevealMapEffects have no readers — vestigial state that would otherwise re-invite the deleted behaviour.

nodes.label: Reveal-artifact cleanup on round transition
nodes.rationale: The round-ended cleanup only cleared some reveals; both city reveals and country wrong-guesses draw the same sources, so clearRevealSources must fire unconditionally at the round boundary or stale arcs/markers survive into the next round.
nodes.community_name: line-gradient reveal animation + Reveal-artifact cleanup on round transition

nodes.label: Preserve user zoom on country selection Plan
nodes.rationale: Selecting a country from a close-in view made the camera recede to roughly world zoom, discarding the user's navigation context.
nodes.norm_label: preserve user zoom on country selection plan

nodes.label: flyToCountry zoom clamp
nodes.rationale: One-expression fix: clamp the computed target zoom against map.getZoom() via Math.max, so selection re-centres but never decreases the user's zoom. Contained to one module; four unit cases cover small country, large country above/below the computed zoom, and reduced-motion composition.

nodes.label: UX Smoothening Plan (PR1 + PR2)
nodes.rationale: Two sequential PRs: PR1 rewrites launcher copy, restructures composition, adds a tomorrow-countdown and softens the daily game-over screen; PR2 changes the first-load posture so the map is the homepage. UI vocabulary moves from 'free' to 'unlimited' while analytics event names stay unchanged for backwards compatibility.

nodes.label: useNextDailyCountdown hook
nodes.rationale: Computes hours/minutes until local midnight and ticks every 60s; the unit logic lives in the hook so the LauncherCountdown component test can stay small and clock-mocking is confined to one place.

nodes.label: LauncherCountdown component
nodes.rationale: Purely presentational 'Next puzzle in 4h 23m' line, mounted only when both modes are already played — it exists to give the exhausted-for-today state a forward-looking answer instead of a dead end.

nodes.label: Map-first load posture
nodes.rationale: useLauncherVisibility changes a single boolean rule so a bare hash returns visible:false — the map becomes the homepage and no modal blocks a cold visitor. Carries funnel risk, which is why the plan tracks it explicitly and pairs the change with a stateful header CTA so the daily stays reachable.

nodes.label: Stateful header CTA pill
nodes.rationale: Replaces the bare icon play button with a three-state pill plus a streak chip and a mobile combined form, wired to a new header_cta_clicked analytics event — it is the compensating affordance for removing the auto-opening launcher modal.

nodes.label: ensureLauncherDismissed / openLauncher e2e helpers
nodes.rationale: Renaming dismissLauncher to ensureLauncherDismissed encodes the new posture in the helper name: the launcher may or may not be open on a bare load, so the helper must be a conditional no-op rather than an unconditional dismissal. openLauncher is its inverse for tests that need the launcher visible.

nodes.label: 'free' to 'unlimited' vocabulary rename
nodes.rationale: UI vocabulary changes from 'free' (which reads as a pricing tier) to 'unlimited' (which reads as a play mode), but analytics event names deliberately stay on the old spelling so historical funnel data remains comparable.

nodes.label: UX Smoothening Phase 2 — PR1a Plan (narrowed)
nodes.rationale: Narrowed by critical review: B1 dropped because a composition refactor would relitigate a closed Phase 1 decision, C1 dropped as low-value polish, and the C2 icon swap dropped because the proposed glyphs were admitted mediocre. What remains is two small additive changes.

nodes.label: History-panel per-cell memory tooltip
nodes.rationale: Threads country/city name + score into each calendar cell as a title="" tooltip. Accepted as a desktop-only affordance because title tooltips only render on hover; the cell's primary affordance stays navigate-to-reveal on tap, so mobile loses nothing.

nodes.label: Satellite-toggle title attribute
nodes.rationale: The title mirrors the action of clicking ('Switch to map view' when satellite is on) rather than the current state, so the hint answers what will happen. A data-satellite-active attribute is added purely so e2e can assert state without reading pixels.

nodes.label: Daily-already-played UX Plan
nodes.rationale: The played-state card read as 'the game instantly ended'; the fix gives a one-tap keep-playing affordance from both the played card and the reveal overlay. Tombstoned 2026-06-12: the daily feature it built was removed in PR #97.

nodes.label: Play-unlimited CTA (card + reveal overlay)
nodes.rationale: Teal primary 'Play City'/'Play Country' button demotes See-reveal to a small emerald secondary row, and DailyRevealOverlay shifts initial focus from the header X to the new Play button so keyboard users land on the forward action. Target mode resolves as revealState.modeId ?? readLastMode().

nodes.label: Daily-city per-click feedback + reveal-overlay swap Plan
nodes.rationale: Daily-city attempts did not feel registered. Three independent revertable commits add per-click distance/points text and a persistent marker, then swap the daily-city game-over to DailyRevealOverlay. Tombstoned 2026-06-12 (daily removed in PR #97).
nodes.norm_label: daily-city per-click feedback + reveal-overlay swap plan

nodes.label: Persistent city click marker
nodes.rationale: The intermediate-flash effect in useRevealMapEffects is narrowed to country-only and a separate city-only effect persists the marker until the next click or round-end, because a flash that disappears reads as 'the click did not register'. circle-color is reset in the round-end geometry effect so the persisted marker cannot leak its colour into the next round.

nodes.label: Daily-city game-over renders DailyRevealOverlay
nodes.rationale: GameController branches its game-over render so daily-city gets DailyRevealOverlay while everything else keeps GameOverOverlay; daily-country deliberately stays on GameOverOverlay. The Esc handler is left unchanged on purpose.

nodes.label: Daily flow polish Plan
nodes.rationale: Post-#91 polish: three mechanical hygiene items plus eliminating the 'Not played.' flash and closing the refresh-during-race window. Tombstoned 2026-06-12 (daily removed in PR #97).

nodes.label: recordDailyCompletion dual-call pattern
nodes.rationale: Called from two sites in useGameAnnouncements: advanceNow's endsGame branch (the production path, which is where the pre-finalize write closes the refresh-during-race window) and the game-over useEffect's daily branch (a fallback for the __funworldmap_game.finalize() test seam and any future direct finalize dispatch). Writing history before finalize is what removes the 'Not played.' flash.

nodes.label: announcedGameOverRef dedup
nodes.rationale: Needed because recordedRef is now set pre-finalize, so it can no longer double as the screen-reader-announcement dedup flag; a dedicated ref keeps the 'Game over' announcement firing exactly once.

nodes.label: Daily content on a data branch Plan
nodes.rationale: Move the generated daily index off main so main stops accruing chore(daily) bot commits, while preserving production freshness, per-date provenance, and the scheduled-workflow keepalive. Rewriting the 137 existing bot commits was declined by the owner. Tombstoned 2026-06-12 (daily removed in PR #97).

nodes.label: Orphan data branch for the daily index

nodes.rationale: Delete the daily-puzzle feature everywhere and reframe the launcher as a free-play hub whose hook is per-mode personal-best high scores. Two phases so the app is shippable after Phase A; Phase B then deletes the now-unreachable best-of-N machinery test-first.

Task order guarantees typecheck and the unit suite stay green after every commit: readers of a symbol are removed before the symbol, and each telemetry event type dies in the same commit as its last call site.

nodes.rationale: Existing users carry daily history, resume blobs, and streak keys in localStorage; a one-time cleanup runs first so no later task has to reason about orphaned keys, and returning users are not left with unreadable state.

nodes.label: Review Follow-ups Plan
nodes.rationale: Nine PR-sized phases ordered by dependency: the paint reconciler (Phase 2) lands before the work built on its surface (Phases 4, 6), and shared test utilities (Phase 5) land before the gap tests that consume them (Phase 6). nodes.label: applyCountryBaselinePaint single owner
nodes.rationale: Establishes one function in mapLayers as the sole writer of country baseline paint, so satellite mode, compare dimming, and selection highlighting stop racing each other over the same properties.

nodes.label: useCountryBaselinePaint reconciler hook
nodes.rationale: Wraps the single-owner paint function in a reconciler with matrix tests covering every combination of satellite/compare/selection state, so rewiring the existing hooks is guarded by pinned expectations rather than manual inspection.

nodes.label: Style-latch clear-on-load fix
nodes.rationale: A latched style flag survived a style reload, leaving paint stale. The fix is written TDD-style with a suite-level e2e assertion that provably fails before the fix, because a latch bug is exactly the kind that a passing-after test cannot distinguish from luck.

nodes.label: MODE_IDS compile-time exhaustiveness
nodes.rationale: Makes the MODE_IDS array provably exhaustive against the ModeId union at compile time, so adding a mode cannot silently skip registration sites.

nodes.label: Shared BorderChip component
nodes.rationale: Border chips were duplicated across the single-country and compare panels; extracting one component prevents the two copies from drifting in styling and interactivity rules.

nodes.label: Shared test utilities (13 duplication sites)
nodes.rationale: Three shared utilities replace 13 duplicated sites, migrated one commit per group so a bad migration is bisectable. Sequenced before the unit-test gap phase so new tests are written against the shared surface rather than adding a 14th copy.

nodes.label: waitForMapLoaded e2e helper consolidation
nodes.rationale: Replaces hand-rolled map-load waits scattered across specs with one helper, and parameterises routeMapTiles so label-contrast's private copy can be absorbed — the same readiness-helper discipline CLAUDE.md mandates for new tests.

nodes.label: eslint-plugin-playwright mechanization
nodes.rationale: Turns the CLAUDE.md flake rules (no waitForTimeout, no force-click) from prose conventions into lint failures, so the 2026-04-28 flake regression pattern cannot silently re-accumulate through review oversight.

nodes.label: Review fixes batch 1 Plan
nodes.rationale: Five bug-tier review fixes that all ride existing seams (a CSS base rule, the useMapInteractions event registry, SearchBar's activeIndex, mapLayers layer definitions, the flyToCountry/useSelectedCountry chain) plus one new 10-line module. Game-mode camera code and useRevealMapEffects deliberately untouched.
nodes.community_name: Review fixes batch 1 Plan + Review Fixes Batch 2 Plan

nodes.label: selectionOrigin (click vs auto) module
nodes.rationale: A 10-line markClickOrigin/takeOrigin module carries the click-vs-auto mark across the URL-hash boundary, because the hash cannot encode provenance and the camera needs to behave differently for a user click than for a programmatic/deep-link selection.

nodes.label: flyToCountry retuned zoom + preserveZoom + panel-aware offset
nodes.rationale: Retunes zoomFromArea, promotes zoom preservation to an explicit preserveZoom option driven by selection origin, and offsets the camera so the open panel does not cover the country.
nodes.norm_label: flytocountry retuned zoom + preservezoom + panel-aware offset

nodes.label: Highlight extrusion maxzoom cap at z6
nodes.rationale: maxzoom:6 on the three extrusion layers stops the highlight walls from dominating the view at close zoom.
nodes.community_name: Highlight extrusion maxzoom cap at z6 + Extrusion fade replaces the z6 cliff
nodes.norm_label: highlight extrusion maxzoom cap at z6

nodes.label: Search: Enter commits the top result
nodes.rationale: Auto-activating index 0 means Enter commits without a preceding ArrowDown, which also lets the e2e spec drop its ArrowDown-before-Enter dance while keeping arrow-key coverage.
nodes.community_name: Search: Enter commits the top result
nodes.norm_label: search: enter commits the top result

nodes.label: Tooltip overflow + stale hover artifacts
nodes.rationale: A .country-tooltip without top/left produced page scrollbars; hover artifacts survived camera movement until the hover-clearing helper was also registered on movestart.

nodes.label: Review Fixes Batch 2 Plan
nodes.rationale: Four approved streams: game basemap tuning, panel polish, compare-view camera framing, and the batch-1 deferred cleanups. The game gate is session.status === 'playing' so reveal and game-over render normally; satellite default and space-dark backdrop are intentional and untouched.
nodes.community_name: Review fixes batch 1 Plan + Review Fixes Batch 2 Plan

nodes.label: Single-owner map-layer pattern
nodes.rationale: Every map change goes through an existing single-owner function in mapLayers (the repo's #111 pattern): basemap visibility gets one new owner and border emphasis extends the existing baseline-paint owner, so no two code paths write the same layer property.

nodes.label: layoutConstants module + drift alarm
nodes.rationale: Camera geometry that both fly helpers depended on lived as a private panelOffset in flyToCountry; hoisting it into a shared module and guarding it with a drift-alarm test means a CSS panel-width change cannot silently desynchronise the camera offset.

nodes.label: Extrusion fade replaces the z6 cliff
nodes.rationale: The batch-1 maxzoom:6 cap made the highlight walls vanish abruptly; an interpolated fade replaces the hard cliff so the transition reads as intentional.
nodes.community_name: Highlight extrusion maxzoom cap at z6 + Extrusion fade replaces the z6 cliff
nodes.norm_label: extrusion fade replaces the z6 cliff

nodes.label: Hide basemap labels during play
nodes.rationale: Basemap place labels give away the answer while guessing; visibility is toggled through a single new owner gated on session.status === 'playing' so reveal and game-over still show labels.

nodes.label: Satellite border emphasis during play
nodes.rationale: With labels hidden and satellite imagery as the default basemap, country boundaries become unreadable; emphasising borders during play restores the spatial cues the game needs without reintroducing the answer.

nodes.label: Compare-view camera framing
nodes.rationale: Compare mode needs both countries framed at once, which the single-country fly helper cannot express; the shared layout constants make the two-country framing consistent with the panel-aware offsets used elsewhere.

nodes.label: Fake-map helper consolidation
nodes.rationale: Collapses the remaining duplicate fake-map test doubles into one, closing the multi-implementation problem first catalogued in the 2026-05-15 cleanup assessment. Test files must live under src/** to satisfy tsconfig.app.json, and a same-basename .tsx next to an existing .ts is forbidden because TypeScript silently drops one.

nodes.label: Vertical Slice Phasing
nodes.rationale: Each phase produces a deployable artifact so problems are caught early; chosen over horizontal layering.

nodes.label: Data-Collection-Tool-First Strategy
nodes.rationale: Building the data collection tool before any UI validates the data model against real REST Countries + CIA Factbook data first.

nodes.label: Phase Dependency Graph
nodes.rationale: Phases 4 (Search) and 5 (Theme) are independent after 3b and may run in either order; all others are sequential.

nodes.label: Test-After Per Phase
nodes.rationale: Implement feature, verify in browser, then lock down with Playwright; Vitest reserved for data-tool merge/validation logic.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages Hosting
nodes.rationale: Free, git-integrated, deployable via GitHub Actions; consistent with the no-backend principle.

nodes.label: Globe Projection (always on)
nodes.rationale: Globe is always active rather than an opt-in toggle because users would miss the headline feature; MapLibre transitions to Mercator above zoom 12 automatically.

nodes.label: Atmosphere & Sky via setSky
nodes.rationale: atmosphere-blend zoom interpolation makes the globe read as a planet; called on theme change alongside fog handling, static so reduced-motion is respected.

nodes.label: Satellite-Linked 3D Terrain
nodes.rationale: AWS Terrain Tiles (terrarium, no API key) activate only with satellite; no separate terrain toggle because flat vector colors on 3D terrain look unnatural.

nodes.label: Country Name Tooltip (raw DOM)
nodes.rationale: Implemented as a raw DOM div rather than React to avoid a re-render on every mousemove; hidden on touch devices since there is no hover equivalent.

nodes.label: ResetViewControl
nodes.rationale: Custom MapLibre IControl flying back to the default world view; double-click zoom disabled entirely to prevent a race with the country selection click handler.

nodes.label: Zero New npm Dependencies Constraint
nodes.rationale: Every feature is built into MapLibre GL JS 5.23.0, so the bundle size increase is zero.

nodes.label: Side-by-Side Country Comparison
nodes.rationale: Limited to A vs B only; three+ country comparison and rich delta visualizations rejected because plain data is clearer.

nodes.label: Compare Picking Mode
nodes.rationale: Crosshair canvas cursor is the only visual mode indicator; a glow on all countries would be expensive and noisy.

nodes.label: Comma-Separated Compare Hash (#FRA,DEU)
nodes.rationale: Extends the existing single-country hash rather than replacing it, keeping all prior deep links valid.

nodes.label: Compare Map Layer Stack
nodes.rationale: Filter-controlled glow/fill/border/extrusion layers mirroring the selection stack; base fill opacity is set to a fixed value (not an expression) while comparing so hover cannot fight the dimming.

nodes.label: Toast Component
nodes.rationale: Portal to document.body with role=status/aria-live=polite; single toast at a time, no queue — a new message replaces the current one.

nodes.label: Share Link Button
nodes.rationale: URL is constructed explicitly from state rather than read from location.hash to avoid a hash-sync race; window.prompt is the clipboard fallback.

nodes.label: Slash and Escape Keyboard Shortcuts
nodes.rationale: Only two shortcuts because they are user-expected and self-discoverable, so no help overlay is needed; Escape priority is exit compare → close panel → clear search.

nodes.label: MapLibre Navigation Control Restyling
nodes.rationale: CSS scoped to bottom-right controls so the bottom-left attribution is not broken; the home icon is replaced by a globe-with-arrow because 'home' conceptually means 'go back', not 'reset orientation'.

nodes.label: Findings Implementation & Voting Removal Design
nodes.community_name: Findings Implementation & Voting Removal De… + Voting Feature Silent Scrub

nodes.label: Voting Feature Silent Scrub
nodes.rationale: No deprecation marker or ADR; historical plans keep their voting mentions because rewriting them would be revisionist — only forward-looking docs are scrubbed.
nodes.community_name: Findings Implementation & Voting Removal De… + Voting Feature Silent Scrub

nodes.label: WorldMap.tsx Hook Refactor
nodes.rationale: Splits a 786-LOC god component into useMapInstance/useMapInteractions/useSelectionHighlight/useMapTheme/useSatelliteMode plus pure lib modules; each map.on must have exactly one attaching hook and a matching map.off in its cleanup.

nodes.label: useMap Shared-Ref Context
nodes.rationale: Returning refs from a memoized context is the mechanism that lets the map hooks split cleanly while surviving re-renders.

nodes.label: CountryPanel Router Split
nodes.rationale: Splits follow the actual conditional shape (single vs compare) instead of context-izing; neither child receives more than 6 props.

nodes.label: E2E Against Production Bundle
nodes.rationale: Playwright's webServer moves from vite dev to vite preview with a conditional base path so tests exercise what users get; landed before the large refactor so a refactor regression and a test flake stay distinguishable.

nodes.label: ADR Filing Convention
nodes.rationale: Convention doc only — no speculative historical ADRs, because filing ADRs for decisions nobody is revisiting produces low-value retroactive docs.

nodes.label: Forward-Spec Planning Convention
nodes.rationale: plans/ holds forward specs written before code and specs/ holds design docs; retrospective documents belong in docs/systems or an ADR instead.

nodes.label: Panel Focus Management
nodes.rationale: Capture activeElement with useRef + useLayoutEffect before the DOM mutates, restore on close, falling back to the search input.

nodes.label: BasemapBanner Retry + Dismiss
nodes.rationale: Specific copy plus a Retry that re-runs probeBasemap; dismissal persists for the session via sessionStorage. Provider failover is deliberately deferred to its own spec.

nodes.label: Deferred Cleanups Design
nodes.community_name: Findings Implementation & Voting Removal De… + Voting Feature Silent Scrub

nodes.label: LAYER Id Constant Map
nodes.rationale: Replaces 60+ string-literal layer ids so typos are caught at compile time; addHighlightStack deliberately keeps its internal ${prefix}-glow concatenation so the constants need not encode the suffix structure.

nodes.label: setFog Dead-Code Removal
nodes.rationale: map.setFog is a Mapbox-only API that MapLibre never implemented; the code cast to never, called a non-existent method, and swallowed the TypeError — the fog properties were already being passed to setSky, so deleting the call changes nothing observable.

nodes.label: Stale loaded Closure → loadedRef
nodes.rationale: The map error handler read a stale loaded===false because the init effect's deps omitted it; loadedRef and the loaded state must be written together, recorded as an explicit invariant comment.

nodes.label: useCompareViewDimming Hook
nodes.rationale: Split out of useSelectionHighlight; must be called AFTER useMapTheme because both write country-borders line-opacity on theme change and the dimming hook has to win that race — call order is the highest-risk subtle bug, guarded by a dedicated e2e spec.

nodes.label: Cursor Logic Consolidation
nodes.rationale: The comparePickingMode cursor effect moves out of useSatelliteMode into useMapInteractions where the rest of the cursor logic already lives, leaving the satellite hook to cover only satellite/terrain.

nodes.label: useMap Context Partial Collapse
nodes.rationale: hoveredRef has a single reader so it becomes a local useRef; tooltipRef stays because it is genuinely shared between the instance and interactions hooks and a third useMapTooltip hook would be overkill.

nodes.label: Shared CloseButton + FieldLabel
nodes.rationale: Eliminates the repeated inline X-SVG button and label-plus-SourceTooltip pattern across SingleCountryPanel and CountryColumn; the className prop fully replaces defaults rather than merging.

nodes.label: Satellite as Default Basemap
nodes.rationale: One-line default flip to EOX Sentinel-2 + AWS Terrain; no localStorage persistence of the toggle. Risk logged: EOX imagery is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, which blocks future monetisation without a tile-source swap, and raster tiles cost more mobile bandwidth.

nodes.label: Game-Mode Framework
nodes.rationale: Mode registry plus shared primitives designed so a future mode lands as a single folder with no framework refactor; GameMode carries no generic parameters — the id union grows instead.

nodes.label: Country Pinning Mode
nodes.rationale: Endless streak with 3 lives over the 194 independent countries; ocean clicks are no-ops so lives only deduct on a concrete wrong-country click.

nodes.label: Hybrid Centroid-Distance Scoring
nodes.rationale: Exact country = 100, otherwise round(100 * exp(-distanceKm / 3000)). Distance is measured centroid-to-centroid, not click pixel, because the game unit is countries; clicking an overseas territory therefore scores against the mainland centroid.

nodes.label: Game Session State Machine
nodes.rationale: idle → playing → round-ended → playing/game-over, driven by a single reducer in useGameSession with no external state library.

nodes.label: HashState Discriminated Union
nodes.rationale: The old 23-line comma-splitting upper-casing parser would mangle #game/country-pinning, so it is rewritten rather than patched; all existing country hashes stay backward compatible.

nodes.label: usePersonalBests localStorage Persistence
nodes.rationale: Best score/streak per mode with a graceful in-memory fallback for private-mode browsers; no accounts or server leaderboards, consistent with the no-backend principle. Mid-session state is deliberately not persisted.

nodes.label: __funworldmap_game Test Seam
nodes.rationale: Window global exposing setRound/getSession/endGame in parallel with __funworldmap_map, so Playwright can force deterministic rounds instead of driving the UI.

nodes.label: __funworldmap_guess Removal
nodes.rationale: A window global that doubled as production code and test seam; submitGuessInput moves into GameSessionProvider so App and GameController read one source of truth with no window indirection.

nodes.label: HUD Registration Unification
nodes.rationale: Deletes the module-level attachedHud singleton and side-effect import in favour of the city-guessing pattern of importing the HUD directly in the mode factory.

nodes.label: applyBorderPaintForMode Helper
nodes.rationale: Single shared helper fixing the regression where exiting compare view with satellite on left borders stuck near-invisible; three hooks that wrote border paint independently now funnel through it. Landed test-first — the new e2e fails red on main.

nodes.label: Dark-Mode FOUC Blocking Script
nodes.rationale: Inline head script sets the dark class before first paint; no automated assertion because SwiftShader rendering variance makes screenshot tests for it flaky.

nodes.label: GameOverOverlay Focus Management
nodes.rationale: The overlay claimed aria-modal without managing focus; on mount it captures activeElement and focuses Play again, falling back to the map container so keyboard users never land on body. No Tab trap.

nodes.label: Completed-Plans Archive
nodes.rationale: 13 completed plans move to plans/archive/ so the directory matches its own forward-looking convention.

nodes.label: Reveal Text Uses Country Names
nodes.rationale: Names propagate via GuessInput rather than being looked up in the HUD, keeping scoring pure; mirrors the city-mode PointReveal pattern of reading the target name from the round.

nodes.label: City Guessing Mode
nodes.rationale: Fixed 10 rounds, no lives, any map click including ocean is a guess — deliberately unlike Country Pinning where ocean is a no-op. Streak is hidden because a 100-point round needs distance 0, which is effectively impossible.

nodes.label: Game Framework Generalisation
nodes.rationale: GuessInput / RoundSpec / reveal become discriminated unions and the controller — not the mode — computes endsGame, so modes stay pure. Ships atomically with the mode because splitting would briefly break Country Pinning.

nodes.label: City Distance Decay Scoring (DECAY_KM 500)
nodes.rationale: round(100 * exp(-distanceKm / 500)) per round, max 1000 over ten rounds; a skip yields zero points and MAX_DISTANCE_KM, and a defensively-received country input scores zero.

nodes.label: Natural Earth Cities Build Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Top 500 populated places sorted by (scalerank ASC, pop_max DESC) for determinism; country name and flag are joined at build time so there is no runtime cross-dataset dependency, costing ~25 KB of inlining. Id uniqueness is verified and fails the build on collision.

nodes.label: Reveal Marker + Line GeoJSON Sources
nodes.rationale: game-reveal-marker and game-reveal-line are added at game start and torn down on any transition to idle so a stale line never survives into the next game; fitBounds padding is viewport-relative and clamped.

nodes.label: PlayMenu Mode Picker
nodes.rationale: Header popover listing modes most-recently-played first; all transitions go through the URL hash rather than component state so deep links stay consistent.

nodes.label: Deep-Link vs Pool-Load Race Guard
nodes.rationale: Landing on a play deep link before cities.json resolves would crash getMode with an empty pool, so GameController treats the hash as pending until the pool is non-empty.

nodes.label: Micro-Typography Floor (11px minimum)
nodes.rationale: Raises every 10px region badge to 11px; no layout impact because each sits in an already-padded rounded-full container.

nodes.label: Meta-Color Contrast Bump (sand-500 → sand-600)
nodes.rationale: sand-500 on sand-50 is ~4.0:1 and fails WCAG AA at 11-12px; sand-600 reaches ~6.0:1. Only the light half of each pair changes — dark-100 already has adequate contrast on dark surfaces.

nodes.label: Tabular Figures on DataCell Values
nodes.rationale: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on the shared DataCell value so populations and areas align vertically when compare columns stack; non-numeric text is visually unaffected.

nodes.label: Game-First Product Direction
nodes.rationale: The owner clarified the product is game-first, not reference-first, so the 'Cartographer's Table' serif/paper-tone Foundation direction was cut; only product-direction-neutral a11y fixes survived into this spec.

nodes.label: Launcher Modal Landing State
nodes.rationale: Centered modal card over a dimmed blurred map replacing the map-plus-hint-pill home view; z-index sits above the basemap loading overlay so mode cards are clickable while tiles still load.

nodes.label: useLauncherVisibility State Machine
nodes.rationale: visible = isBareRoot(hash) && !dismissed && session idle. Deliberately in-memory with no storage, so deep links bypass it for free and a fresh tab always re-shows it; the known cost is that browser Back does not undo a dismissal.

nodes.label: LauncherModeCard
nodes.rationale: Whole card is a single button with no nested interactive elements; personal best renders an em-dash placeholder at the same visual height when gamesPlayed is 0.

nodes.label: PlayMenu Deletion
nodes.rationale: The launcher becomes the single source of truth for mode picking, so the popover is removed rather than kept alongside; outside-click close is not needed for a modal.

nodes.label: lastMode Module
nodes.rationale: LAST_MODE_KEY plus read/write helpers extracted out of PlayMenu so the launcher and the game-start flow share one definition instead of a floating string literal.

nodes.label: Launcher Inline Focus Trap
nodes.rationale: ~20-line inline trap over three focusable elements; a focus-trap library is an explicit non-goal. aria-modal makes the rest of the DOM inert without aria-hidden.

nodes.label: Launcher Dismiss Paths
