nodes.rationale: Explicit link, first non-empty search change, mode-card click, and Escape dismiss; the backdrop deliberately absorbs clicks so a stray map click cannot dismiss. Each path defines its own focus-return target.

nodes.label: dismissLauncher E2E Helper
nodes.rationale: Introduces e2e/helpers.ts so the thirteen existing map-first specs migrate through one shared beforeEach rather than each open-coding the dismissal.

nodes.label: Retention Program v1 Design (tombstoned)
nodes.rationale: Tombstoned 2026-06-12: the daily-puzzle/retention feature was removed in PR #97 (2026-05-30). Kept unmodified for history — not to be implemented from.

nodes.label: Daily Puzzle
nodes.rationale: One shared country + city per calendar day for all players, turning the existing modes into a daily habit without a runtime backend; leaderboards and push notifications are excluded because they would require operating one.

nodes.label: Three Attempts, Best-of-3 Scoring
nodes.rationale: Distance feedback between attempts intentionally narrows the search space — the game becomes about narrowing in, not cold-guessing — and there is no penalty for using all three, so recovery is rewarded. Mode scorers stay unchanged; the session aggregates.

nodes.label: Cross-Session Daily Streak
nodes.rationale: Derived on completion rather than on page load, so a user returning after a gap sees 1 rather than 0; lastMilestoneShown prevents a milestone celebration double-firing across tabs.
nodes.community_name: Cross-Session Daily Streak + Local-Date Timezone Policy

nodes.label: Plain-Text Share Artifact
nodes.rationale: Wordle-style emoji attempt strip encoding each attempt's score quintile; country and city names are deliberately omitted so the puzzle is preserved for recipients who have not played.

nodes.label: Daily Content Pipeline
nodes.rationale: A GitHub Action running 4x daily appends to a rolling 30-day public/daily/index.json; only past-and-today entries are emitted to protect against view-source spoilers, and regeneration is idempotent because the picker is deterministic (sha256 seed with rejection sampling).

nodes.label: Curated Daily Country/City Pools
nodes.rationale: Curated for political neutrality (excluding contested sovereignty cases), unambiguous recognition, global balance, and stable ids; a CI validator fails the build if a pool id is missing from the data files. Superseded 2026-05-03 by the canonical-195 dataset filter.

nodes.label: Launcher Calendar History Panel
nodes.rationale: 5x7 grid of the past five weeks with per-mode dots and streak connectors; cells are reveal-only because retroactive free-play of past dailies is deferred. Nested Escape closes the panel before dismissing the launcher.

nodes.label: Local-Date Timezone Policy
nodes.rationale: Puzzle and streak both key off the user's local date to avoid the 'my streak broke while I slept' footgun; toLocaleDateString is deliberately avoided because it returns locale-varying formats, so YYYY-MM-DD is assembled manually. Cost is a bounded ~6h sync lag east of UTC.
nodes.community_name: Cross-Session Daily Streak + Local-Date Timezone Policy

nodes.label: #daily Hash Route Family
nodes.rationale: Adds a daily variant to the discriminated-union hash state; the no-mode form anchors the launcher to a date and is what the share button emits so recipients see both puzzles. Future and rolled-off dates toast and redirect.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Web Analytics (passive layer)
nodes.rationale: Free, cookieless, no PII, captures page views and web vitals with no per-event code; chosen despite requiring a one-time DNS move to front GH Pages with Cloudflare. Its free tier cannot do custom events, which is why a second layer exists.

nodes.label: Analytics Worker + Analytics Engine (custom-event layer)
nodes.rationale: A ~60-line Worker validates known event names and writes typed columns to Analytics Engine, both inside free tiers. The client wrapper no-ops under doNotTrack and under Playwright, capturing to __testAnalytics for assertions instead.

nodes.label: Bucketed Analytics Event Props
nodes.rationale: Score quintiles and integer date-ages rather than raw values, deliberately chosen to avoid cardinality explosion and user fingerprinting.

nodes.label: Country-Pinning Guess-Phase Fixes + Round-End UX Reform
nodes.community_name: Country-Pinning Guess-Phase Fixes + Round-E… + Country News Feed Design (tombstoned)
nodes.norm_label: country-pinning guess-phase fixes + round-end ux reform

nodes.label: Guess-Phase Tooltip Suppression
nodes.rationale: Hovering a country revealed its name, invalidating the game. useMapInteractions reads useGameSessionContext directly rather than prop-drilling a flag, because the rule driving tooltip content is fundamentally a game-state concern. Highlight/extrusion/cursor behaviour is preserved.

nodes.label: GuessByNameButton Removal
nodes.rationale: The typing input let players type the name already shown in the HUD. Only the UI is deleted — submitGuessInput stays because it is the universal guess path used by map clicks, the skip button, and the test shim.

nodes.label: Round-End Country Panel
nodes.rationale: Rendered as a sibling JSX branch rather than by relaxing the existing !gameActive gate, because compare-related props are meaningless in-round and two clearly-named render sites read better than one branch full of conditionals.

nodes.label: SingleCountryPanel inGameRound Prop
nodes.rationale: Hides Compare and Copy-link and relabels Close to Continue; documented as in-round chrome only, with a note that a third in-round behaviour should trigger a refactor to a discriminated state object.

nodes.label: Continue / Auto-Advance Round-End Flow
nodes.rationale: Wrong guesses wait for Continue so the panel is read; correct guesses auto-advance in 3000ms. Early-skip is scoped to Enter/Escape/Space plus the button — a window-level pointerdown would fire on clicks inside the panel and falsely advance.

nodes.label: Retention v1 Finishing (Phases 4+5) Design (tombstoned)
nodes.rationale: Tombstoned 2026-06-12: the daily-puzzle/retention feature was removed in PR #97 (2026-05-30). Kept unmodified for history.

nodes.label: chromium E2E Deflake Prereq
nodes.rationale: Stops normalising admin-merges. The earlier static-data-fetch-race hypothesis is explicitly wrong — countries.json and cities.json are bundled — so diagnosis from traces must come before any presumed fix, with a documented 3-day cap after which a tactical readiness-assertion fix is accepted and logged as not-root-cause.

nodes.label: Disjoint Playwright Project testMatch
nodes.rationale: chromium and chromium-gpu run different files, so a green chromium-gpu run does not validate the same tests as a red chromium run — the reason admin-merging on gpu-green was unsafe.

nodes.label: DailyShareBlock
nodes.rationale: Mounted in both GameOverOverlay and DailyRevealOverlay so a share recipient can immediately re-share — that is the viral loop. Only mounts when at least one mode was played, and a cancelled native share sheet does not fire the event because it represents intent, not a button press.

nodes.label: WCAG 2 AA Axe Pass
nodes.rationale: The previously-dropped GameOverOverlay axe test was not flaky — it surfaced real pre-existing contrast violations, so the job is fixing them, not re-stabilising infrastructure. Extends the existing accessibility spec rather than forking an a11y folder; per-surface descope is allowed but must be recorded in both the PR and the roadmap with the axe rule id.

nodes.label: Origin-Based Share URL
nodes.rationale: buildShareText takes originUrl as a parameter so it stays pure and snapshot-testable, and runtime substitutes window.location.origin — so a missing custom domain never blocks the share flow.

nodes.label: Country News Feed Design (tombstoned)
nodes.rationale: Tombstoned 2026-06-12: the country-news feature was removed in PR #40 (2026-05-12). Kept unmodified for history.
nodes.community_name: Country-Pinning Guess-Phase Fixes + Round-E… + Country News Feed Design (tombstoned)

nodes.label: Guardian Open Platform Source
nodes.rationale: Single-source by owner choice; multi-source aggregation was rejected for adding editorial-ranking complexity and TOS surface. Requires a hand-curated cca3-to-tag table because the Guardian's taxonomy is irregular (USA is us-news, not world/usa).

nodes.label: Static News Build Pipeline
nodes.rationale: A daily GitHub Action commits per-country static JSON so no runtime backend is introduced; the ~1.1s throttle keeps the full run inside the free-tier quota, and a failed run simply leaves yesterday's data live with no user-facing error.

nodes.label: Continent-Level Region Fallback
nodes.rationale: Sparse-coverage countries are topped up from a continent tag, deduped by article id and visually badged; Americas and Antarctic map to null because no single Guardian tag unifies them, so those countries get an honest empty state instead.

nodes.label: Build-Time HTML Sanitiser
nodes.rationale: trailText is stripped of tags and entity-decoded at build time, not on the client, so the client never receives HTML for that field.

nodes.label: CountryNewsSection Component
nodes.rationale: Fetches per-country JSON on mount with loading / empty / error states that never break the panel; gated on !inGameRound because news is noise during a country-pinning round-end.

nodes.label: relativeTime Helper
nodes.rationale: Hand-rolled ~30-LOC formatter rather than a dependency, preserving the zero-new-runtime-dependency constraint.

nodes.label: Guardian → GDELT Migration Design (tombstoned)
nodes.rationale: Tombstoned 2026-06-12: country-news was removed in PR #40; the 'execute when monetisation becomes concrete' deferral is void because the migration in fact shipped the same day it was specced (PR #17).
nodes.community_name: Country-Pinning Guess-Phase Fixes + Round-E… + Country News Feed Design (tombstoned)

nodes.label: GDELT 2.0 Doc API Source
nodes.rationale: Chosen for unrestricted commercial-use licensing, no API key to rotate, and ~8000 outlets of coverage; accepted trade-offs are no trailText summary field and algorithmic hybridrel ranking that occasionally outranks major outlets.

nodes.label: Commercial-Use Licence Gate
nodes.rationale: Guardian Open Platform's free tier forbids commercial use, so this migration is the gate on turning ads on — the spec was written ready-to-execute and deliberately parked until monetisation became concrete.

nodes.label: cca3 → FIPS-10-4 Lookup
nodes.rationale: GDELT filters on FIPS, which diverges from ISO alpha-2 in ~40 of 249 cases (Germany GM, Switzerland SZ, China CH). The code IS the query input, not defensive metadata; codes also sidestep the Georgia/Chad/Niger name-collision problem entirely.

nodes.label: locationcc: Query Operator Choice
nodes.rationale: Verified against the live API on 2026-04-24: locationcc surfaces articles about a country from any English outlet, whereas sourcecountry restricts to domestic outlets and fails for non-English-primary countries; plain location rejects 2-character arguments, and the language code must be the full word 'english', not 'eng'.

nodes.label: Animated Reveal, Mobile Tap Reliability, and Playwright Coverage
nodes.rationale: A revision pass corrected an earlier misdiagnosis of the mobile-tap bug as a dual-handler collision, dropped mobile-firefox from the matrix (Firefox hard-rejects isMobile), and dropped great-circle helper language as a globe-projection fidelity concern only.
nodes.community_name: Animated Reveal, Mobile Tap Reliability, an…
nodes.norm_label: animated reveal, mobile tap reliability, and playwright coverage

nodes.label: Animated Distance-Line Reveal
nodes.rationale: Players previously had no way to see how far off a wrong guess was. Correct guesses keep the border-pulse with no line; the dashed pattern survives because the paint expression is never mutated, only the source data.

nodes.label: slerpLngLat
nodes.rationale: ~12 lines of spherical slerp reusing the file's existing haversine for angular distance, with a near-zero-distance degenerate guard.

nodes.label: tessellateArc
nodes.rationale: MapLibre renders a 2-vertex LineString as a Mercator-straight path, which warps visibly on the globe at long distances; a 64-vertex polyline follows the geodesic closely enough and costs only ~60 cheap trig calls, so it is applied unconditionally.

nodes.label: computeRevealAnimationPlan
nodes.rationale: Pure function extracted for unit testing; returns null on a missing centroid or skipped round so the caller falls back to the border pulse rather than throwing, and reduced-motion short-circuits duration to zero.

nodes.label: clickTolerance: 8 Mobile Tap Fix
nodes.rationale: MapEventHandler.click silently drops a click when the mousedown-to-click delta exceeds the 3px default; a finger rolls 5-10px on a phone and Firefox-Android's touch synthesis preserves that delta, which is why the bug was Firefox-only. dragPan uses a separate higher threshold so drag detection is unaffected. Not empirically reproduced pre-ship, so a real-device checklist gates the merge.

nodes.label: queryRenderedFeatures 4px Bbox
nodes.rationale: Mapbox-recommended hit-testing pattern; helps taps on coastline-adjacent tiny islands without changing behaviour for large polygons, applied uniformly rather than scoped to mobile.

nodes.label: Playwright Mobile Project Matrix
nodes.rationale: mobile-chromium, mobile-webkit, and desktop-firefox-touch. The Firefox project cannot spread the Pixel 7 descriptor because isMobile is hard-rejected by Firefox. A one-test GPU spike verifies each project's WebGL init before the full specs are written, and CI cannot run Firefox-Android at all — real-device reproduction stays a manual-QA step.

nodes.label: E2E Timing Sweep Design
nodes.community_name: E2E Timing Sweep Design + Three Consecutive Green CI Runs Gate

nodes.label: waitForTimeout Anti-Pattern
nodes.rationale: The seven known flakes are not seven independent bugs — they share one style: an arbitrary sleep followed by an assertion on default polling. On hardware GPU the sleeps are ample; on software ANGLE every operation is 3-5x slower and the budgets blow.

nodes.label: Per-Project CI-Aware Timing Defaults
nodes.rationale: Tight locally for fast fail feedback, generous in CI for the slow chromium-gpu project; slow defaults only cost time when something is genuinely broken because passing tests resolve on state arrival, not timeout expiry.

nodes.label: State-Based Wait Replacement Patterns
nodes.rationale: Five patterns covering assertion-with-timeout, per-iteration session-status sync, reduced-motion bypass, hash polling, and raising a safety-net fallback that was masquerading as the happy path. Every replacement preserves the original assertion's intent so no real bug is masked.

nodes.label: Reduced-Motion Animation-Tax Bypass
nodes.rationale: A ten-round game costs 30-60s of pure animation under software ANGLE. Tests that verify game-flow termination rather than the animation itself emulate reduced motion, reusing the production reduced-motion branch for identical coverage at no animation budget — but this is deliberately not applied to specs that ARE about the animation.

nodes.label: Three Consecutive Green CI Runs Gate
nodes.rationale: The acceptance bar is 'kill the seven known flakes', not 'every conceivable flake is dead'; a new out-of-scope flake is documented rather than treated as blocking.
nodes.community_name: E2E Timing Sweep Design + Three Consecutive Green CI Runs Gate
nodes.norm_label: three consecutive green ci runs gate

nodes.label: Security Hardening + Reveal Camera + Tutorial Click Fix
nodes.norm_label: security hardening + reveal camera + tutorial click fix

nodes.label: GDELT URL Protocol Allowlist
nodes.rationale: Filtering at ingest time means the committed static JSON can never carry a javascript:/data:/file: URL to the client; a bad article URL drops the article, a bad thumbnail merely nulls the image so the article stays useful.

nodes.label: VITE_TEST_HOOKS Seam Gating
nodes.rationale: Vite inlines the env flag so rollup dead-code-eliminates the seams from production while Playwright keeps them via --mode e2e. Two gating shapes are used deliberately: wrap-line where the effect does other work, early-return where the effect exists only to manage seams. A grep-based CI gate was rejected as fragile in favour of a manual PR-checklist grep of dist/.

nodes.label: Tutorial Dismisses on First Guess
nodes.rationale: The tutorial's pointer-events-none let clicks fall through and silently consume attempts while its z-index hid the wrong-guess pulse, so three accidental wrongs ended the game. Keying dismissal on currentAttempts.length > 0 works for both modes because country-pinning stays playing while city-guessing flips to round-ended.

nodes.label: Reveal Camera Follows the Line Head
nodes.rationale: fitBounds over-zoomed on transcontinental misses. jumpTo is used rather than easeTo because easeTo queues an internal MapLibre animation that fights the rAF loop, which must remain the single source of animation timing; the t=0 snap is acceptable since the user just clicked a country already in view. Deletes the now-dead fitPadding helper.
nodes.norm_label: reveal camera follows the line head

nodes.label: Game-Flow Bugfix Design
nodes.rationale: Most user-visible problems in the 2026-04-25 assessment trace to one structural seam, so the spec collapses it rather than patching symptoms; daily mode is preserved and improved, not removed.

nodes.label: recordAttempt/submitGuess Reducer Collapse
nodes.rationale: Splitting one logical guess into two actions with different semantics is the gap daily best-of-3 fell into. The collapsed reducer derives lastOutcome from the BEST attempt, so the round-end animation always matches the score; streak also keys off best points. The combination attemptsPerRound>1 with maxRounds null is structurally unsupported and rejected at start.

nodes.label: completeNow Action + Done Button
nodes.rationale: Wires the previously-orphaned revealEarly action to a visible commit action so the player chooses when to stop. Rendered as a primary teal button distinct from the End-game underline link because Done is the expected path and End-game is the escape hatch.

nodes.label: Daily Resume Persistence
nodes.rationale: A new funworldmap-daily-resume key plus a resume reducer action so a refresh no longer forfeits in-progress attempts; Escape still forfeits deliberately and clears the blob. The clear happens only after writeHistory succeeds so a quota failure cannot orphan a completed day.

nodes.label: AttemptsIndicator + Per-Attempt Feedback
nodes.rationale: Pip dots plus a colour flash per attempt; the +X pts toast is the deliberate secondary channel for colour-blind users, and under reduced motion the colours still apply because they are informational, not decorative.

nodes.label: Shared focusTrap Utility
nodes.rationale: installFocusTrap replaces the Launcher's first/last-only handler and gives DailyRevealOverlay the focus management its aria-modal claimed but never had.

nodes.label: deep_link_opened Telemetry Redesign
nodes.rationale: Single fire-point in the GameController hash bootstrap kills the double-fire; the outcome enum becomes start|resume|reveal|redirect, 'invalid' is dropped as unreachable, and the country-deep-link fires are deleted outright. Backward compatibility with the existing dataset is explicitly abandoned since no live dashboards pivot on it.

nodes.label: Personal-Bests v1 → v2 Key Bump
nodes.rationale: Daily scores had been leaking into the per-mode free-play bests store. v1 is wiped rather than migrated because it is polluted, and the daily game-over branch stops calling record at all — fixing the leak at both ends.

nodes.label: No-ADR Decision for the Reducer Collapse
nodes.rationale: Per the ADR README, a decision that can live as a paragraph in a system doc should; the collapse is internal to one file and will not recur as a contested choice, so it gets a file-header comment and an overview.md subsection instead.
nodes.norm_label: no-adr decision for the reducer collapse

nodes.label: 14-Day Soak Window with Rollback Gates
nodes.rationale: Explicit prioritised gates rather than vibes: a zero count of outcome:'resume' across 48h of continuing daily play is the primary signal that the persistence layer never executes, and a >50% drop in daily_completed means the new flow blocks completion.

nodes.label: Session state, not URL hash, as the daily oracle
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: GameController and GameOverOverlay re-parsed window.location.hash to answer 'is this a daily?'. The hash is also a routing input that useMapInteractions.clickMap mutates on ocean clicks (onDeselect -> history.replaceState), so one off-target click corrupted the whole end-of-game flow. Coupling routing state to session state is the defect; making the session carry the daily date decouples them.
nodes.norm_label: session state, not url hash, as the daily oracle

nodes.label: dailyDate field on GameSession
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Set by start/resume, preserved by attempt/completeNow/advance/overrideRound via ...state spread, reset to null by endGame via ...EMPTY. Optional new field with default null so no localStorage migration or backward-compat shim is needed.

nodes.label: Gate click-deselect during active gameplay
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Defense-in-depth: even with session.dailyDate, silently rewriting the hash mid-game breaks refresh/share/browser-back semantics. sessionRef mirrors the existing onSelectRef/onDeselectRef pattern so the listener stack stays attached once.

nodes.label: finishFree reducer action
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: 'End game' in free mode silently abandoned the run with no game-over UI and no personal-best write. finishFree transitions playing/round-ended to game-over so the existing recordedRef branch fires; it refuses when dailyDate !== null because daily keeps abandon semantics.

nodes.label: Drop redundant round-end App-level announcement
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Both mode HUDs already render an inline role=status whose content is richer than the App-level dispatchAnnouncement. Deleting the App-level block also auto-resolves the 'Plus 1 points' pluralization bug, since all three strings live inside it.

nodes.label: Clear stale aria-live region after each announcement
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: 8s is enough for a screen reader to read the longest (~80 char) announcement; each new announcement cancels the prior timer so 'Game over. Final score N.' does not persist after navigation away.
nodes.norm_label: clear stale aria-live region after each announcement

nodes.label: subscribeReducedMotion API
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: prefersReducedMotion() already returns a live value; only useMapInstance captured it once at map construction for the initial pitch. Scope narrowed to that one knob — the other four call sites read fresh inside callbacks and pick up OS toggles automatically.

nodes.label: Phased fix-and-monitor flake approach
nodes.rationale: The 2026-04-28 prescription ('remove waitForTimeout / force:true anti-patterns') was stale — grep found 1 waitForTimeout and 0 force:true. Diagnosis must be evidence-driven per failing test. All phases land on the in-flight PR branch rather than follow-ups, to avoid doubling the review cycle.

nodes.label: dismissLauncher Header-remount race
nodes.rationale: The project's last waitForTimeout(150) waited for the Header to remount after the launcher closed. On CI's 5-10x slower runner it races, so newly-attached Header controls (theme-toggle) fail actionability. Replaced with a deterministic attached-state wait on a Header child.

nodes.label: Five-consecutive-green CI criterion
nodes.rationale: Deliberately locked as a forcing function: if unreachable, the outcome is 'escalate to option D (real GPU CI runner)', never 'relax the criterion'. Explicitly refuses retries or blanket timeout bumps as a substitute for diagnosis.

nodes.label: routeMapTilesRich stub coverage hypothesis
nodes.rationale: If the stub's URL patterns miss the light-positron basemap's tile URLs, MapLibre waits indefinitely on an intercepted-but-unfulfilled fetch, so data-map-loaded never appears within 90s. Investigation is required before the fix.

nodes.label: Camera coherence rule: preserve the user's view
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: One rule consolidates four separate complaints: the user's view is preserved on every game lifecycle event (start, round advance, end); the reveal animation is the sole place the camera intentionally moves on its own.
nodes.norm_label: camera coherence rule: preserve the user's view

nodes.label: Remove vestigial initialCameraView mode property
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Per the project memory 'Remove obsolete code and tests', deleting code with no reader is the rule. Both modes effectively become 'preserve', so a field kept only to satisfy an old type contract is dead weight. Commit ordering matters: the reader must be deleted before the property or the typecheck breaks.

nodes.label: line-gradient reveal animation with easeTo camera
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Per-frame setData triggers a source/tile rebuild 60x; jumpTo teleports with no interpolation so the hand-computed cubic ease only chose an arc index. Setting the line gradient is a paint update (no re-tiling) and easeTo lets MapLibre interpolate the camera, decoupling smoothness from JS frame jitter. Requires lineMetrics:true for ['line-progress'].
nodes.norm_label: line-gradient reveal animation with easeto camera

nodes.label: Clear reveal artifacts on round transition
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Cleanup must mirror setup: whatever the round-ended effect drew, it tears down when status leaves round-ended. clearRevealSources runs unconditionally (mode-neutral) because both country wrong-guesses and city reveals draw the marker+arc; the idle-clear effect stays as a defense-in-depth net.
nodes.norm_label: clear reveal artifacts on round transition

nodes.label: Preserve user zoom on country selection design
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.norm_label: preserve user zoom on country selection design

nodes.label: Monotonic zoom clamp in flyToCountry
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Math.max(map.getZoom(), zoomFromArea(area)) rather than skipping flyTo when computed <= current: a no-op would also skip the re-center, and clicking a country in the viewport corner should still bring it to centre — just without backing the camera out.

nodes.label: Search auto-fit tradeoff of the uniform clamp
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Accepted cost: searching Brazil while zoomed into Paris lands at z9 over Sao Paulo instead of auto-fitting the country. Scoping the clamp to clicks would mean threading an origin argument through three modules to fix a workflow with no telemetry. Documented migration path: thread origin and gate the Math.max on origin === 'click'.
nodes.norm_label: search auto-fit tradeoff of the uniform clamp

nodes.label: UX smoothening: launcher, first-load posture, copy pass
nodes.norm_label: ux smoothening: launcher, first-load posture, copy pass

nodes.label: Map-first first-load posture
nodes.rationale: A free product felt like it had a gate: useLauncherVisibility keyed dismissal on component state, so the modal returned on every reload. New rule — bare hash returns visible:false (the map is the homepage), #daily/YYYY-MM-DD still opens the launcher so share deep-links keep working.

nodes.label: Stateful header Play CTA pill
nodes.rationale: Replaces the icon-only triangle with a labeled pill carrying three states (unplayed solid dot / partial outline dot / done muted). On <sm the streak chip and pill merge into one target — two tap targets on a 320px viewport would crowd; one wider target is honest.

nodes.label: 'free' to 'unlimited' UI vocabulary pass
nodes.rationale: 'free' conflated 'no paywall' with 'non-daily mode'. Display strings change only; internal mode IDs stay. The free_started analytics event deliberately keeps its old name — renaming would be a backwards-incompatible schema change against saved Cloudflare dashboards, so UI and analytics intentionally diverge.

nodes.label: header_cta_clicked analytics event
nodes.rationale: Ships so the new funnel (header_cta_clicked -> launcher_opened -> daily_started) can be compared to the historical launcher_auto_opened funnel, making the map-first posture change independently revertible on evidence.

nodes.label: ensureLauncherDismissed / openLauncher e2e helpers
nodes.rationale: The launcher-on-bare-hash assumption was baked into helpers. The rename makes the helper a conditional no-op that works in both the old and new posture without silently skipping work tests intended; openLauncher covers tests that need it open. No test.fixme quarantines are acceptable for this slice.

nodes.label: UX smoothening phase 2: composition polish + discoverability
nodes.norm_label: ux smoothening phase 2: composition polish + discoverability

nodes.label: Launcher composition reduction to three zones
nodes.rationale: Principle 'two zones if real; three zones if honest' — phase 1 proposed two zones but shipped five, so phase 2 owes a more honest collapse. Phase 1's retention nudge copy must be preserved as a caption line; it was a deliberate retention choice, not throwaway copy.
nodes.norm_label: launcher composition reduction to three zones

nodes.label: StatsPanel — a home for unlimited personal bests
nodes.rationale: Principle 'every promise has a home': phase 1 removed the Best (free) footer promising a future stats view that never existed. Priority is medium-low and explicitly conditional — build only if a user asks or to close the integrity loop, otherwise defer and drop the Stats link from B1. Modal, not a route, to avoid hash-routing surface growth.
nodes.norm_label: statspanel — a home for unlimited personal bests

nodes.label: History panel as a memory log
nodes.rationale: Multi-color region tinting was rejected: 5+ saturated colors on tiny cells would read as noise. A native title-attribute tooltip is the memory affordance instead — cheap, accessible, no new component.
nodes.norm_label: history panel as a memory log

nodes.label: Persistent '/' keyboard hint in the search bar
nodes.rationale: Principle 'discoverability without overlays': the transient hint toast is missed by visitors who don't linger. A kbd badge inside the search input's right edge, visible only when empty and unfocused, aria-hidden because screen readers don't need it.
nodes.norm_label: persistent '/' keyboard hint in the search bar

nodes.label: Satellite toggle two-state icon + action tooltip
nodes.rationale: The striped-globe SVG technically communicates state via color + aria-pressed but not legibly. The title tooltip shows what clicking will DO ('Switch to map view'), not the current state.
nodes.norm_label: satellite toggle two-state icon + action tooltip

nodes.label: Conditional first-visit intro toast
nodes.rationale: Principle 'conditional first-visit intro': don't build onboarding speculatively. Gated on 14+ days of phase 1 funnel data showing new visitors aren't finding the daily. If built: a one-time localStorage-gated toast, NOT a modal and NOT a tour.

nodes.label: Daily-already-played UX design (tombstoned)
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Tombstoned 2026-06-12: the daily-puzzle/retention feature this spec designed was removed in PR #97. Kept unmodified for history — do not implement from it.

nodes.label: Played-card primary + secondary affordances
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: One emerald button did both 'I'm done' and 'tap to see reveal', so a played card read as a play entry point and the game felt like it instantly ended. Split into a teal primary Play button and a small secondary reveal row; the emerald border and check stay as the done signal.

nodes.label: Play-unlimited CTA in the daily reveal overlay
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Adding a bottom close link would violate 'one obvious way to close', so only the Play button is added and the header X stays the sole close affordance. No new analytics event: the hash router's free_started on boot is the durable signal, and firing launcher_dismissed from the reveal overlay would be a category error.
nodes.norm_label: play-unlimited cta in the daily reveal overlay

nodes.label: Daily-city per-click feedback + reveal-overlay swap (tombstoned)
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Tombstoned 2026-06-12: designed a daily-puzzle feature removed in PR #97. Kept for history.

nodes.label: Per-click HUD reveal line during play
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Attempts 1 and 2 of best-of-3 felt unregistered: a 10px marker held 600ms and a +pts toast gated on pointsEarned > 0 (which fails for far clicks scoring 0). Loosening the revealLine gate to include playing + best-of-N reads the latest attempt; the branches are mutually exclusive via the leading status check, so nothing double-renders.
nodes.norm_label: per-click hud reveal line during play

nodes.label: Persistent city intermediate click marker
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Split the one intermediate-flash effect in two with distinct invariants. Country keeps its anchor ref (re-flashing an already-seen highlight on resume is noise); city deliberately has NO anchor because the marker is the current state of 'where you last clicked' — re-painting on resume restores it. Replace-only, never accumulate.

nodes.label: Daily-city game-over renders DailyRevealOverlay
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: A numeric GameOverOverlay with no city-name reveal read as 'ends abruptly'. Branch only on daily + city; daily-country and free play are byte-identical. Dual Escape handlers are kept deliberately — both are idempotent, and narrowing would regress Escape-to-close for the overlays that have no Esc handler of their own.

nodes.label: Daily flow polish design (tombstoned)
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Tombstoned 2026-06-12: designed a daily-puzzle feature removed in PR #97. Kept for history.

nodes.label: Pre-finalize daily history write
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Recording in a post-paint useEffect caused a one-frame 'Not played.' flash and left the resume blob alive ~16ms after history was supposed to be written, so a reload in that window lost the run (the reducer's resume guard returns state unchanged for a full attempt list). Moving record+clear+track into advanceNow before the finalize dispatch makes the localStorage state consistent before any render.

nodes.label: Dual-call helper + post-paint fallback
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: advanceNow is the only production path, but the __funworldmap_game.finalize() test seam and any future direct finalize dispatch bypass it. Keeping the useEffect branch as a fallback covers both, with recordedRef dedup preventing a double write; a separate announcedGameOverRef keeps the announcement firing once. The helper is module-scope so exhaustive-deps doesn't demand it as a dependency.

nodes.label: Stale triage-marker and docstring cleanup
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Triage markers are a signal pointing at suspected bugs; carrying stale ones degrades the signal (this session's planning was misled by them). Only 3 of 5 were verified stale — the two documenting deliberate silent degradation on localStorage failure stay. Likewise the hook docstring implied a uniform anchor pattern that no longer exists.

nodes.label: writeLastMode on both onPlayUnlimited call sites
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Both reveal-route and game-over Play-unlimited handlers navigated to #game/<mode> without persisting the preference, diverging from Launcher.startFree's canonical pattern, so the next launcher visit defaulted to the wrong mode.
nodes.norm_label: writelastmode on both onplayunlimited call sites

nodes.label: Daily content on a data branch design (tombstoned)
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Tombstoned 2026-06-12: designed a daily-puzzle feature removed in PR #97. Kept for history.
nodes.norm_label: daily content on a data branch design (tombstoned)

nodes.label: Orphan data branch for the generated daily index
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: 137 of 417 commits on main (33%) were chore(daily) bot commits burying real history — the most visible blemish for a showcase repo. main holds only code; the index becomes a generated artifact. The branch still preserves per-date provenance and the GitHub 60-day scheduled-workflow keepalive, since a push to any branch resets the clock.
nodes.norm_label: orphan data branch for the generated daily index

nodes.label: No prebuild generation hook invariant
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: A prebuild: daily:generate hook would regenerate a fresh index over the one fetched from data, silently breaking provenance. Generation is wired only into predev and the Playwright webServer command — never the production build path. Related gotcha: npm pre<name> hooks match exact script names, so a build hook would not fire for build:e2e.

nodes.label: Reproducibility constraint waived
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: The owner confirmed a past-but-still-in-window day's puzzle may change on regeneration (no meaningful userbase yet). That removes the need to preserve exact past picks, so the data branch is for provenance and keepalive, not correctness — which is what makes the whole design cheap.

nodes.label: Workflow name is load-bearing for the deploy chain
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: deploy.yml's workflow_run trigger matches on the literal name 'Daily puzzle index'; renaming daily-puzzle.yml's name: would silently break the deploy chain.
nodes.norm_label: workflow name is load-bearing for the deploy chain

nodes.label: Flagship continuation roadmap
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: An umbrella roadmap, not an implementation plan: each workstream is independently shippable and gets its own plan and PR. Sequencing is risk-ascending so the cheapest work lands first and the release tag captures the fully-polished state.

nodes.label: Workstream A — ADRs and doc reconcile
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Four ADRs backfilled (MapLibre WebGL2 basemap, URL-hash single source of truth, useGameSession reducer model, daily data branch). Because the ADR README calls historical backfill a poor reason, the README gains a note acknowledging the exception so guidance and directory contents stop contradicting each other.
nodes.norm_label: workstream a — adrs and doc reconcile

nodes.label: Workstream B — lazy-load Sentry (deferred)
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: DEFERRED 2026-05-30. A measurement-gate spike (alias-stub build: 483,527 B -> 477,746 B gzip) found Sentry's real main-chunk cost is ~5.8 KB gzip, not the estimated ~60 KB, because @sentry/react v10 tree-shakes with tracing and replay disabled. A hand-rolled error boundary plus a three-site restructure and lazier crash reporting is not justified by a ~1.2% reduction.

nodes.label: Measurement gate before optimization effort
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Measure the actual contribution first; if the real saving is materially below the estimate, descope or defer rather than spend L effort on an unverified payoff. The bundle-budget check fails closed on unaccounted assets, so any re-baseline must carry measurement evidence rather than loosening the check.

nodes.label: Workstream C — lint warnings and App.tsx effect extraction
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: C1 clears 6 warnings (5x missing mapRef in useRevealMapEffects deps, 1x react-refresh export split), scoped disables only with justification, never a blanket disable. C2 extracts 2-3 self-contained effects (useFirstVisitHint, useAppKeyboardShortcuts, useAnnouncer) from the ~550 LOC AppInner; strictly behavior-preserving with the e2e a11y/keyboard/launcher specs as the regression net.
nodes.norm_label: workstream c — lint warnings and app.tsx effect extraction

nodes.label: Workstream E — resolve open dependabot PRs
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Surfaced during review, not in the original assessment: a perpetually-red vite-ecosystem bump is a visible blemish on a flagship repo's PR list. Each PR must end merged-green or closed with a one-line rationale.
nodes.norm_label: workstream e — resolve open dependabot prs

nodes.label: Remove the Daily — high scores as the retention hub
nodes.rationale: For city guessing a best-of-3 one-pin-per-day format does not fit a 10-round pinpoint game, and the daily UI (streak, calendar, reveal, share) reads as ceremony around a mechanic that does not reward it. Owner's call: drop the daily for both modes and let personal-best high scores drive return visits.
nodes.norm_label: remove the daily — high scores as the retention hub

nodes.label: Phase A — remove the daily feature
nodes.rationale: Two-phase split came out of the code audit: after Phase A the app is daily-free and the best-of-N machinery is dead-but-inert (attemptsPerRound is never > 1), so Phase B becomes a pure dead-code deletion behind its own test gate rather than a risky simultaneous change. daily_done_low_score_prompt is deliberately deferred to Phase B because removing its type early would break the build mid-phase.
nodes.norm_label: phase a — remove the daily feature

nodes.label: Phase B — delete the dead best-of-N machinery
nodes.rationale: Test-first reducer surgery: drop dailyDate, resume, completeNow, attemptsPerRound/attemptsRemaining/currentAttempts, deriveBest, the Done button and AttemptsIndicator. Highest-risk item in the change; isolated behind an already-shippable Phase A and gated on green free-play reducer/announcement tests plus a manual play loop.
nodes.norm_label: phase b — delete the dead best-of-n machinery

nodes.label: Launcher as free-play high-score hub
nodes.rationale: Keeps the launcher shell (focus trap, data-animation-state, map-first visibility) and rewrites the mode card around usePersonalBests, with a 'No games yet — play your first' state instead of 'Best: 0'. Flagged observation: because cold load is map-first, the high-score hub sits behind a Play click; surfacing scores more prominently is deferred.

nodes.label: One-time legacy daily localStorage cleanup
nodes.rationale: Idempotent removeItem of the two inert daily keys inside try/catch (private-mode safe), mirroring the v1 self-clean already in personalBestsStore. Ensures a returning visitor with leftover keys sees no console errors from a missing /daily/index.json.

nodes.label: Leaf-first deletion with a grep completion gate
nodes.rationale: Delete leaf modules first and let tsc/Vite surface every dangling reference, resolving top-down; a final grep sweep over src/scripts/.github/cloudflare-worker gates completion. Historical dated specs and plans are deliberately NOT rewritten — they stay as the record of what was built.
nodes.norm_label: leaf-first deletion with a grep completion gate

nodes.label: CI coverage honesty pass
nodes.rationale: 13 of 38 spec files never run on CI (chromium-only matrix plus 10 testIgnore exclusions), including game-country-pinning and both axe audits. Decision: document the local-only specs, reference a tracking issue from testIgnore, and delete a dangling testMatch entry — no CI behavior changes; re-enabling specs stays a roadmap item needing a GPU runner.

nodes.label: Corpus archive sweep and tombstones
nodes.rationale: 36 shipped plans sat un-archived with ~11 describing deleted features and no supersession markers, so the corpus had no lifecycle. Fix is archive + one-line tombstone headers + README policy alignment — explicitly no content rewrites, preserving the historical record.

nodes.label: Living-docs reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Living docs contradicted the code in ~15 places (reset-view behavior, search highlighting, zoom table, focus management, data-collection fallback, bundle numbers, flag sourcing) and playwright-matrix.md still presented ten deleted daily specs as live.

nodes.label: Explicitly droppable optional phase
nodes.rationale: Extending lint/typecheck gates to e2e/ and scripts/ may surface latent errors; the phase carries an explicit abort criterion (stop and file an issue if >20 errors surface) so unknown fallout cannot hold the rest of the cleanup hostage. Similarly, a flaky strengthened webgl-restore assertion is to be quarantined per CLAUDE.md rules rather than weakened.

nodes.label: Review follow-ups design
nodes.rationale: Scope rule: unconditioned work only. Items whose deferral conditions still hold (search match highlighting needs a UI design, messages.ts routing needs i18n to start, the preamble-prefix helper needs a fourth duplication site) stay out.

nodes.label: useCountryBaselinePaint single-owner reconciler
nodes.rationale: One hook becomes the single owner of country-fill opacity and country-borders paint across {satellite, inCompareView, resolvedTheme}, eliminating the documented 'must run AFTER' call-order dependency. useCompareViewDimming narrows to highlight colours + hover suppression and is renamed useCompareViewHighlight. Matrix unit tests pin every cell before the hooks are rewired.

nodes.label: Clear the latched 'style' error on map load
nodes.rationale: MapLibre's load event proves the style loaded, so a pre-load latched 'style' error is cleared there. timeout, webgl-lost and country-data latches are unaffected and post-load tile hiccups keep routing to BasemapBanner. Verified TDD at the suite level: the new 'clean load leaves no [data-map-error]' assertion fails before the fix in the stubbed environment.
nodes.norm_label: clear the latched 'style' error on map load

nodes.label: Shared unit-test utilities in src/test/
nodes.rationale: Dedupes a CountryData factory duplicated 5x, a matchMedia stub 6x, and a fake-map wrapper 2x across 13 sites. Ordered before the unit-test-gap phase so the new gap tests consume the shared utilities.

nodes.label: eslint-plugin-playwright on the e2e lint block
nodes.rationale: Mechanizes the CLAUDE.md waitForTimeout and force-click bans. Type-checked ESLint for e2e is declined on latency grounds — the plugin's syntactic rules cover the high-value gap. Expected fallout: no-standalone-expect flags helpers.ts's exported expect.poll helpers, which is configured around rather than restructured. Abort criterion: >20 non-trivial errors means exclude and report.
nodes.norm_label: eslint-plugin-playwright on the e2e lint block

nodes.label: waitForMapLoaded + parameterised routeMapTiles
nodes.rationale: Absorbs label-contrast's ~70-line copied tile interceptor into a shared helper, so map-load waiting and tile stubbing have one implementation instead of per-spec copies.

nodes.label: Review fixes batch 1 design
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Bug-tier slice of the 2026-07-10 critical review: five fixes with confirmed root causes, each verified twice (live browser plus code path). Settled in-session: satellite-by-default stays, space-dark backdrop stays, game-round camera carry-over stays (later amended by F4).

nodes.label: Tooltip initial position causes page scrollbars
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Measured root cause: .country-tooltip is position:absolute with no initial top/left, so before the first hover it sits at its static position at the end of body and extends the document 12px past the viewport, producing permanent scrollbars on every viewport. Adding top:0;left:0 is invisible because JS positions it on every show.
nodes.norm_label: tooltip initial position causes page scrollbars

nodes.label: Clear hover state on movestart
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Tooltip and hover feature-state were cleared only on layer mouseleave, so a camera move without mouse movement (search selection, deep link, reveal fly-to) stranded a 'Tanzania' tooltip over Rome. Reusing the mouseleave clearing on movestart is safe during drags because the next mousemove re-applies hover.

nodes.label: Search Enter commits the top result
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: activeIndex reset to -1 on every keystroke meant 'japan' + Enter did nothing, against the product's Search First principle; mouse hover primed Enter, so keyboard-only users got the worst path. Auto-activating index 0 makes the highlighted row telegraph what Enter will do — a deliberate, visible change to the dropdown's resting look.
nodes.norm_label: search enter commits the top result

nodes.label: Extrusion maxzoom cutoff
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: A-B-A confirmed: fixed-height fill-extrusion highlights (hover 60km, selection 80km) read as a subtle lift at world zoom, but an 80km column over a ~1km polygon at z11.5 with pitch projects as a ribbon crossing the viewport. maxzoom:6 keeps the lift where it works; fill/border/glow carry the highlight past it.

nodes.label: Origin-aware selection camera
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Implements the migration path the 2026-05-17 spec documented. Selection flows through the URL hash so origin cannot ride on it; a transient module-scoped mark (markClickOrigin/takeOrigin) is consumed in resolveHash, which runs on EVERY hashchange, so the mark can never go stale — even a click re-selecting the current country consumes it. Default 'auto' for search, chips, deep links and back/forward.

nodes.label: Retuned zoomFromArea formula
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: The old 11 - 1.7*log10(area) clamped to z2 for every country above ~196,000 km2, so Japan, Germany, Italy and the UK all 'flew' to the world view. 10.8 - 1.35*log10(area) makes mid-size countries the subject of the frame while continental giants still resolve to the globe. The 2026-05-17 spec declared the formula out of its scope; this item deliberately brings it in.

nodes.label: Panel-aware framing offset
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: flyTo centers in the full viewport but the panel covers the right 392px (desktop) or bottom ~45% (mobile sheet). Spike first: prefer flyTo padding if it behaves under the globe projection, else offset, which is projection-agnostic. Read the real panel width from the component rather than hardcoding.

nodes.label: Explicitly-no-action findings
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: READ-usage buffer console warnings were root-caused to MapLibre's globe-projection ProjectionErrorMeasurement readback loop — not app code, no user impact — and the Vatican polygon offset is 1:50m source resolution. Both documented so the next reviewer does not re-chase them.

nodes.label: Review fixes batch 2 design
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Four fix-shaped streams land now; per-country political tinting is deferred to its own design-first cycle (batch 3) because it needs genuine palette exploration. The selectionOriginRef threading simplification is consciously declined, not deferred — the mechanism works, is tested and documented, so collapsing it is churn without behavior change.

nodes.label: applyBasemapLayerVisibility single owner
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Hiding symbol layers during play would be undone by useSatelliteMode's own layer flipping on a mid-game satellite toggle. Following the repo's single-owner pattern, basemap layer visibility gets ONE owner with one rule: a non-custom layer is visible iff !satellite, and symbol layers additionally require !playing. Tested as a truth table plus the toggle-mid-game ordering case.

nodes.label: Satellite border emphasis while playing
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: applyCountryBaselinePaint, already the single owner of the border/fill baseline, gains a gameActive input; border width was previously set only at layer creation, so the owner starts writing line-width per mode change. Goal: active play never shows the answer (no labels in map view) while borders stay legible in satellite.

nodes.label: Panel polish — five verified defects
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Title truncation (line-clamp-2 instead of truncate), region-chip mid-phrase wrap, border chips for six non-selectable neighbors (ESH/GIB/GUF/HKG/MAC plus a static UNK->Kosovo fallback) so no raw code shows, a timezones '+N more' toggle, and dropping the focus ring from the programmatically-focused heading (Chromium matches :focus-visible for script focus, but the heading is never keyboard-focusable so the ring communicates nothing).

nodes.label: Compare-view camera framing both countries
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: cameraForBounds over the two centroids with 80px padding (absorbing centroid-vs-outline underframing) plus the panel-aware offset. Exiting compare deliberately leaves the camera in place, following the preserve-the-user's-view philosophy. An antimeridian pair is asserted to produce a valid camera — verified, not assumed.

nodes.label: Layout constants with a class-string drift alarm
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Tailwind class literals cannot consume TS constants, so a unit test asserts the panel components' class strings still contain the constant-derived values. Geometry drift then fails a test instead of silently mis-framing the camera. The test is intentionally brittle — that is its job — so its failure message must name which constant to update.
nodes.norm_label: layout constants with a class-string drift alarm

nodes.label: Zoom-interpolated extrusion fade
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Replaces batch 1's hard maxzoom:6 cliff with fill-extrusion-height interpolated from full height at z4.5 to 0 at z6.5 plus maxzoom:7 as a backstop, so the lift shrinks smoothly during flights instead of vanishing in one frame. EXTRUSION_MAX_ZOOM is exported so tests stop pinning a literal.

nodes.label: UX & visual program (2026-07 audit follow-up)
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Built from 12 screenshots across every core flow, seven dimension reviews against the code, and three adversarial critique passes. Of 51 findings, 3 were killed as duplicates, ~12 revised, and 3 disproven against the code. Seven independently shippable workstreams; four audit items conflicting with settled decisions are held for an explicit owner call.

nodes.label: Workstream A — quick wins batch
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: 16 unanimously-endorsed fixes, but explicitly NOT 16 commits: the 2026-07-27 interaction audit found A4+A5 rewrite the same panel blocks (separate commits guarantee conflicts) and A12 makes a hint pill appear in states many specs click through. Commit shape is ~10, ordered so hit-area padding (A13) applies once to the final button set.

nodes.label: A1 — Escape mid-round records the run
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: The Escape exit handler called endGame() + writeIdleHash during playing and city round-ended, so the score was never shown and the personal best never recorded — while the HUD End-game button correctly routed through finishFree. Routing those Escapes through finishFree aligns the two paths; game-over Escape keeps endGame because finishFree is a no-op there and the hash must reset.
nodes.norm_label: a1 — escape mid-round records the run

nodes.label: A13 — 44px touch-target convention
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Sheet header buttons ~36px, search-clear ~24px (the WCAG 2.5.8 floor exactly) and HUD text buttons ~16px (below even that floor) get padded hit areas to >=44px on touch surfaces without changing glyph sizes. The convention is pinned by a unit test in the layoutConstants style rather than left as a review habit.

nodes.label: A8 — stray clicks stop destroying comparisons
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: With compareWith set, a click on a third country fell through to select() and tore down the pair. Reinterpreted: third country replaces B, clicks on A or ocean are no-ops. Descoped to map-click semantics with a four-case e2e matrix; the border-chip-per-column clause moved to workstream C, which rebuilds those columns. Must resolve the interaction with the click-origin mark, since a replace-B click now feeds preserveZoom into the compare camera path.
nodes.norm_label: a8 — stray clicks stop destroying comparisons

nodes.label: Workstream B — a political map that shows its politics
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: The default satellite view hides every basemap label, so a political world map shows no country names at any zoom, and the vector view is dominated by roads and admin-1 labels in one AA-failing gray. This is the 'batch 3' political-legibility cycle batch 2 anticipated — pursued through labels, cased borders and a selection spotlight instead of per-country fill tinting.
nodes.norm_label: workstream b — a political map that shows its politics

nodes.label: B1 — app-owned country labels on satellite
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Glyphs decided and live-verified: text-font ['Noto Sans Bold'] via the positron style's existing glyphs endpoint, which stays loaded because satellite is a raster layer inside the always-loaded positron style, not a style swap. One cached ~77 KB PBF covers all 249 Latin-1 names, so no font assets ship and no bundle-budget change is needed. Self-hosting brand-font PBFs is rejected because the glyphs URL is style-global in MapLibre 5. Game gating needs a new explicit rule (visible iff satellite && !hideLabels) because the visibility owner deliberately skips custom country-* layers. E2E asserts seam visibility only, never rendered text, since the tile stub serves empty glyph PBFs.
nodes.norm_label: b1 — app-owned country labels on satellite

nodes.label: B2 — cased country borders on satellite
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: A cased pair (dark casing under a light line) via the single paint owner, which batch 2 already taught to write border width per mode. The cased resting state supersedes batch 2's satellite-play emphasis branch — the values are near-identical, so the gameActive branch and its truth-table rows are retired and play and rest render the same borders.
nodes.norm_label: b2 — cased country borders on satellite

nodes.label: B3 — vector political mode pass
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: A layer-id matcher demoting roads and admin-1 boundaries and restyling symbol layers by tier. The program's one real drift-risk item because it depends on third-party style layer ids, so it is severed from the B tranche and safe to slide or cut. Tested against a committed style-JSON snapshot fixture (no network in npm run check) and must fail open at runtime — unmatched layers stay positron-default, never broken. No scheduled fetch job; fixture refresh is a documented manual step.

nodes.label: B4 — selection as spotlight, not sticker
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Selecting France covered it with 0.32-opacity fill, making the requested country the least legible thing on screen. Inverted: a country-dim layer filtered to everything EXCEPT the selection (and compare partner), selection fill dropped to <=0.10, tighter glow. Load-bearing invariant: every queryRenderedFeatures call in app and e2e code is layer-scoped today, which is the only reason a new fill layer cannot pollute click handling or ocean-click preconditions.
nodes.norm_label: b4 — selection as spotlight, not sticker

nodes.label: B5 — reveal fill pulse
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: A dedicated country-reveal-fill layer rather than a borrowed selection layer — the single-owner lesson. Test contract: map paint animation is invisible to Element.getAnimations, so the waveform is unit-tested and e2e polls the settled fill-opacity through the map seam instead of data-animation-state.

nodes.label: B6 — compare camera via asymmetric padding
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: A screen offset cannot fix zoom sized to the full viewport, so country B still slid under the panel; asymmetric cameraForBounds padding replaces the mechanism while keeping batch 2's behavior contract. The wide-pair midpoint fallback and globe-scale guard encode live findings and are kept until the padding approach passes the same live cases.
nodes.norm_label: b6 — compare camera via asymmetric padding

nodes.label: Workstream C — a compare view that actually compares
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Each column rendered fields conditionally, so rows misaligned when one country lacked a value and compare silently dropped Timezones and Independent. One shared field-definition array drives desktop grid and mobile list, with paired bars scaled to max(A,B) and delta chips for numerics, and identical categorical values collapsed into one centered row.
nodes.norm_label: workstream c — a compare view that actually compares

nodes.label: Workstream D — a panel that answers 'so what?'
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Hero stats with world ranks computed from the in-memory 195-country dataset (zero data cost); attribution collapses 11 hover-only, tabIndex=-1, keyboard-unreachable per-field rings into one Tab-reachable footer that expands to the full field-to-source table, preserving granularity one interaction away.
nodes.norm_label: workstream d — a panel that answers 'so what?'

nodes.label: Workstream E — Observatory visual identity
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Direction chosen by the owner on 2026-07-27 from a three-option review (Night Atlas / Observatory / Expedition Ledger). The globe is the observed object and the chrome a calibrated instrument. Deliberate trade-off: the 'fun' in funworldmap lives in copy and game feedback, not the hue system — if the live pass reads cold, the correction is copy and motion, not new hues.

nodes.label: E4 — two-accent semantic color tokens (ice / signal)
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Two accents with one meaning each: ice = interactive and wayfinding; signal = live game state and loss. Coral retires; teal migrates to ice. Region badges and A5's exception badges are explicitly outside the system — they are data encodings, not chrome accents. Shipped as its own atomic tranche (~92 teal occurrences across 29 files) so users never see a mixed-accent state.
nodes.norm_label: e4 — two-accent semantic color tokens (ice / signal)

nodes.label: E2 — typographic roles and the readout face
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Data readouts move to the system mono stack at zero bundle cost. Known risk: ui-monospace resolves to different faces per OS, so layouts must not depend on exact glyph widths — tabular alignment within one platform is the guarantee, not cross-platform pixel parity. Most surfaces already set tabular-nums, so .text-readout is a face change rather than an alignment fix.
nodes.norm_label: e2 — typographic roles and the readout face

nodes.label: E5 — landing behavior: derived center + idle rotation
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Initial longitude derived from Intl timezone via a static table — no geolocation, no network. Both the derived center and the rotation are disabled under VITE_TEST_HOOKS because host timezone varies between dev machines and CI and camera-dependent specs scan around viewport center. Rotation stops permanently on first interaction, pauses when the document is hidden, and self-stops after ~120s; the recurring cost is the WebGL render loop, not tile fetches (the z1.8 world pyramid is a few dozen cached tiles), recorded so the CDN-churn question stays answered.
nodes.norm_label: e5 — landing behavior: derived center + idle rotation

nodes.label: E8 — instrument chrome grammar
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Corner-tick frames and tight radii are reserved for data surfaces (stat readouts, launcher cards, HUD badges); overlay shells keep the soft-radius backdrop-blur grammar. One boldness locus — the readouts — and everything around them stays quiet.

nodes.label: Workstream F — game feel
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Three reduced-motion-gated CSS-only HUD beats each exposing data-animation-state per CLAUDE.md; no libraries, no emoji. Retention comes from personal bests plus F2's share loop rather than a reinstated daily.

nodes.label: F2 — game-over recap and copy-result share
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Adds history: RoundOutcome[] to the reducer so the overlay can list per-round outcomes, with missed entries clickable into that country's panel — game to lookup, the product's core loop. Copy-result uses navigator.clipboard.writeText, which is safe; only readText is banned per project memory.
nodes.norm_label: f2 — game-over recap and copy-result share

nodes.label: F3 — region filter as the difficulty lever
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: No separate difficulty system — region IS the difficulty lever, and 'Africa only' is the stated educator use case. Personal bests key per (mode, region) extending the v2 key scheme, explicitly applying the v1 daily-pollution lesson. CountryLike must gain region, which it does not carry today.
nodes.norm_label: f3 — region filter as the difficulty lever

nodes.label: F4 — round-start camera ease to world view
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Amends the 2026-07-10 'carry-over is intended difficulty' call on the audit's friction evidence (target Bangladesh, camera parked over Europe — 2-4s of pan/zoom chores per round). Easing to a fixed world zoom while keeping the current center makes the globe reachable in one click without hinting at the target. Test contract changes from 'no move at all' to 'no move toward the target'; e2e waits on !map.isMoving() because camera moves are invisible to Element.getAnimations.
nodes.norm_label: f4 — round-start camera ease to world view

nodes.label: Workstream G — mobile platform feel
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: G1 ships sheet fundamentals (dvh, safe-area padding, one grabber implementation D4 consumes). G2 pointer-drag with snap points is deferred as the riskiest e2e surface in the program, needing its own data-animation-state design. G3 recomputes the camera offset from the actual snap fraction, since panelScreenOffset bakes in the collapsed height only.

nodes.label: Tranche sequencing and pre-agreed cut line
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: E-foundations is pulled forward as its own atomic tranche so C2's compare bars truthfully match already-migrated map fills. A cut line is pre-agreed (B3 -> G4/E7 -> E5 -> F3 -> D3 -> E-remainder) with a named floor that still honors the audit, and no tranche starts before its predecessor's review closes — the program is seven plans, not one.
nodes.norm_label: tranche sequencing and pre-agreed cut line

nodes.label: Seam-based contracts for map paint and camera animation
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: DOM animations expose data-animation-state, but map paint and camera animations are invisible to Element.getAnimations, so they use unit-tested waveforms plus e2e polling through the map test seam — never hand-timed attributes. Reinforced by CI-coverage honesty: 13 of 38 specs are local-only, so axe and animated-path coverage holds only at the local merge-time run.
nodes.norm_label: seam-based contracts for map paint and camera animation

nodes.label: Owner decisions of 2026-07-27
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Round-start camera change approved (ships as F4); light-theme top strip accepted as intended under the space-dark constraint; the shipped timezone '+N more' toggle stays; the daily challenge stays removed, with the date-seeded mechanic recorded only in case the decision is ever revisited.

nodes.label: Calibrated fittings rollout design
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: The owner ran a three-direction live exploration on the country panel header (calibrated & unobtrusive vs. tactile & confident vs. glass & starlight) and accepted calibrated & unobtrusive; this spec rolls the accepted recipe through the remaining named chrome.

nodes.label: The fitting recipe (normative)
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: In-panel controls read as instrument fittings: 1px hairline border, 8px radius, 16px glyphs, quiet tint hovers, ice-family focus rings. Rules are solid hairlines, never dotted. Country-identifying flags >=56px sit on corner-ticked plates; tiny flags do not.

nodes.label: Radius stratification
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: In-card fittings are 8px; free-floating chrome (header chips, search, primary CTAs) stays 12px; pills survive only where the shape is itself a data encoding (badges) or an ambient message (toast/hint). This is why header chips, search and CTA recipes are named non-goals — they are floating chrome, not in-card fittings.

nodes.label: Touch-target constant pins move with the code
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: The accepted header variant's Continue button box measured ~31px — a 44px-floor miss — so it grows to honestly match its constant, and CloseButton's fitted 32px box switches constants. layoutConstants.test.ts pins move in the same change. A pre-existing gap is named but not fixed: no touch-target constant fits the absolutely-positioned 36px launcher dismiss button.
nodes.norm_label: touch-target constant pins move with the code

nodes.label: vitest exclude for .claude worktrees
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: npm run check was sweeping Playwright specs inside .claude/worktrees/**; the existing .worktrees/** exclude predates the new worktree location.

nodes.label: Critique remediation batch design
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Scoped by the owner to 'everything' from a dual-agent design critique (baseline 30/40), then revised the same day after a four-agent code investigation falsified several critique premises.

nodes.label: Premises falsified by code investigation
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Recorded so the critique trail stays honest. Four observations were disproven at HEAD: no sub-300ms city advance exists (the only timer floors at 1800/2000ms); correct country guesses already get a fill pulse, target panel and a 3000ms skippable hold; the game-over scrim only pre-empts the reveal on user-initiated skips; and cold-load mobile deep links do NOT apply the desktop offset. The real defect behind the fourth was different — the offset is never re-applied when the viewport changes afterwards.

nodes.label: A-1 — itemized +N score chip
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Answers the legibility complaint that more wallclock would not fix: the missing beat in both modes was an itemized points readout, not a longer hold. Signal-colored value in the readout face, no emoji, data-animation-state exposed, reduced-motion shows it statically for the same duration.

nodes.label: A-2 — hearts encode life, not loss
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Amends E4's 'hearts render neutral starlight and turn signal when lost', justified by critique evidence that three grey hearts at start read as empty. Signal still means live game state — it now points at what remains rather than what was lost. The unit-test pin and DESIGN.md doctrine move in the same change.
nodes.norm_label: a-2 — hearts encode life, not loss

nodes.label: B-1 — re-apply the camera offset on breakpoint change
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: panelScreenOffset() is evaluated once per fly, so rotating or resizing across the 1024px boundary stranded the country off-screen. Re-centers via the existing flyToCountry with preserveZoom and duration 0 — a jump, not an autonomous animation, keeping the camera-coherence rule intact. Plain resizes inside one breakpoint (URL-bar collapse) drift only tens of px and are deliberately left alone.
nodes.norm_label: b-1 — re-apply the camera offset on breakpoint change

nodes.label: B-2 — micro-target tap assist on coarse pointers
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: A plain map.on('click') handler because the delegated layer listener cannot widen its hit test. Gated via matchMedia rather than originalEvent, because synthetic seam clicks carry no originalEvent. Growing bbox re-queries (±2/±4/±8px) submit the first hit; a genuinely empty ±8px bbox is an ocean miss. Idle-mode and fine-pointer behavior stay unchanged so the e2e exact-point ocean-click preconditions still hold.
nodes.norm_label: b-2 — micro-target tap assist on coarse pointers

nodes.label: C-4 — run-safety end-game confirm
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: finishFree-bound actions route through a focus-trapped confirm whose safe action ('Keep playing') is primary and initially focused, and where Escape inside the dialog keeps playing. Trivial runs (round 1, score 0) skip the dialog entirely. The useEscapeExit contract and its unit pins are unchanged — only the controller's callback changes — and country round-ended Escape-as-advance stays untouched.

nodes.label: C-5 — ocean-click feedback line
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: The tap-assist miss branch announces 'Ocean — pick a country' as a transient role=status line in the HUD: screen-reader announced and auto-clearing, deliberately not a toast, to avoid spam. Applies on fine pointers too, where the miss is an exact-point miss.

nodes.label: C-1 — measured light-mode contrast sweep
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: A minimal measured edit set (light classes only, dark variants untouched) lifting 3.4-3.6:1 text to 4.9-5.75:1, distinguishing the 3:1 non-text floor for icons from the 4.5:1 floor for text glyphs. Icon-only uses that already pass 3:1 are deliberately untouched.

nodes.label: Games are pointer-only (owner ruling)
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Two standing rulings recorded in PRODUCT.md on 2026-08-04: guessing is spatial by definition (typed guessing is never a guess input), and the games are deliberately pointer-only for now — keyboard playability of the guess action was considered and cut, and is suppressed in future critiques via the critique ignore list.
